tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las dgung gi bgrang gzhi lnga bcu tshun gyi ma tshang ba kha skong ba legs byas kyi rgya mtsho spel bar byed pa dad pa'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo mañju a nan+da pu ṇ+ya ya/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las dgung gi bgrang gzhi lnga bcu rtsa lnga tshun gyi ma tshang ba kha skong ba legs byas kyi rgya mtsho spel bar byed pa dad pa'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje can de nyid kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ ngag dbang lha dang dbyer med sa skya pa zhes grags pa gsal ldan pa/ /kun mkhyen gtso bo shākya'i rgyal tshab shes bya ma lus mkhyen cing gzigs/ /dga' chen rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /bsod nams mi zad zab cing rgya che sa gsum skye dgu'i mgon gcig pu/ 1 /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon por 'phags khyod yon tan kun gyi mdzod mnga' zhing / /dpal ldan bla ma rigs brgya'i mgon po dge legs rin chen bye ba'i gter/ /'phrin las bzang po'i lus can yongs kyi re ba'i 'bras bu rtag 'jo ba'i/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bka' drin mnyam med sngags 'chang bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ 2 /zab yang mkhyen brtse nus mthu la sogs bsngags 'os yon tan kun gyi gter/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las gser gyi 'khor los 'dzam gling nor 'dzin kha lo bsgyur/

/rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i zhabs rdul mi 'phrog mos pa'i gtsug gis bsten/ 3 /khyad par rgyal kun ye shes rgyu ma'i gzugs/ /gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog tu snang ba'i lha/ /gos dkar 'dzin pa mchog gi snang brnyan can/ /snying dbus pad mtshor bzhugs la mchog stsol zhig 4 /gang gis rtogs brjod mi zad chu gter ngo mtshar rba rlabs mkhar 'khyud pa/ /zab dang rgya che gting mtha' mi mngon mtha' gnyis rnyog pa dang bral ba'i/ /dge legs rin chen 'byung gnas che las skal ldan yid kyi gdung sel du/ /dad pa'i snyim pas chu thigs tsam zhig rang blo'i mos ngor 'god par bya/ 5 /zhes bya ba 'di la don lnga ste/ sngon gyi rnam par thar pa dpal 'phrin las kyi mgon po chos skyong yid bzhin nor bus lung bstan du stsal ba dang / dam pa rang nyid kyi zhal gyis ji ltar bzhes pa sogs mdor bstan pa'i tshul/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i legs byas kyi 'bras bu nam yang zad pa med pa'i mthus bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid chos srid kyi nyi ma chen por zas gtsang sras bzhin bltams pa nas dgung gi bgrang gzhi lnga bcu rtsa lnga yan la rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag 'khrul zad dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che ji ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul/ lnga bcu rtsa drug nas dgung gi bgrang gzhi drug bcu re gsum bar du gtsug lag zung 'brel la mchog gi spyod pas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshul/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad rjes dag pa'i zhing khams gzhan du rnam dkar gyi 'jug pa ches cher yangs par gzigs pas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdu ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ mthar dam pa gang gi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / lus can thams cad kyi brgyud la ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs 'jug par bya ba'i phyir rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las rgya chen pos kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyi phung po ji ltar spel ba'i tshul lo/

/de la dang po gnyis ni/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho'i klong la rang dbang 'byor pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa rnam dpyod kyi mthu grub cing / chos tshul la mngon par mtho ba'i thub bstan lha khang chen mo'i mkhan thog bcu gcig pa mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod ngo mtshar yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas shing legs pa sngon med gsar du bskrun pa de nyid dang / lha ldan gyi ljongs 'dir dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes yongs la grags pa'i bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas mkhas pa'i bgyi ba rnam pa gsum la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba khro phu nas mkhan rin po che dus 'khor zhabs gnyis par grags pa dpal rgyas dbang po ste/ de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs kyi sgra dbyangs skal bzang dpyid kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba 'dren pa gang gi zhal gyi bum bzang las chos tshul chu gter lta bu ngoms par gsol ba'i bka' drin gyi lhun po gzhal ba'i ched dang / gtsug lag lugs brgya'i sgo la rnam dpyod kyi 'jug pa ches cher yangs shing thugs bskyed kyi lhag bsam gangs ri ltar dkar ba phyag mdzod dbon rin po che bsod nams rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i ngor spel bar mdzad cing / mkhas pa rnams yid 'phrog par byed pa shin tu legs pa 'di dag las rtogs par bya ba las gzhan du bya ma dgos so/ /gsum pa dgung gi bgrang gzhi lnga bcu rtsa drug nas bsgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag ste rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid dgung grangs drug cu rtsa gsum pa zhes pa'i bar gyi gtsug lag zung 'brel la mchog gi spyod pas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ snyigs dus lus can tshogs gnyis rin chen las/ /legs grub mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar lhun po'i sku/

/'gro mang rgya mtsho'i dbus su rtag bzhugs nas/ /thub bstan gling bzhi mdzes pa'i dpal du mdzad/ /ces te/ de yang chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal snga nas/ khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /rab byung dge bsnyen byis pa sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas/ /gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ zhing 'dir skal ba dang mnyam pa'i gdul bya rnams la thun mong du gnang ba rgya mtsho lta bu las/ rang nyid kyis mthong ba dang / rje nyid kyi zhal nas byung ba dang / yang dag pa'i mtshan ma'i stobs kyis nges pa rnyed pa rags rim tsam zhig sgro bkur spangs te brjod par bya'o/ /smras pa/ lung dang rigs pa gnyis su mi 'gal ba'i/ /ngo bo nyid kyi rang bzhin brjod tsam la/ /phul byung rgyan du 'gro ba dam pa'i lugs/ /bzang po'i spyod mchog rjes su mthun par brtsams/ /de yang 'di ltar/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'dren pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'di nyid dgung gi bgrang gzhi drug gi lhag pa'i bcu phrag lngar phebs pa dga' ba zhes pa chu pho 'brug gi lo sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod kyi shar ngos kyi ldebs bris sngar 'phros rnams mthar phyin te/ rab tu gnas pa smin rgyas su sgrub pa'i sgo nas byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba mdzad/ de nas lo de'i dpyid kyi dus na nyang stod rtse chen nas bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pas gsol ba btab ngor dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse rnying mar rigs sras 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas lcam sring / chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen gyi mkhan rin po che/ slob dpon pa sogs bshes gnyen brgya phrag brgal ba rnams dang / gsol ba 'debs pa po rnams la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi zab gnad thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa pan chen nā ro ta pas mkha' spyod dbang mo nyid kyi zhal bum las dngos su nos shing /

pham mthing pa sku mched las gzhan du ma gnang ba'i slob bshad zab mo rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rgya mtsho lta bu mnga' ba'i snying po'i snying po mchog tu gyur pa/ skal ldan dad 'dun can rnams tshe 'di nyid la mkha' spyod nyams dga'i grong du myur bar bgrod pa'i gsang lam/ mchog sgrub pa'i dmar mo skor gsum gyi nang tshan/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba'i cho ga zab mos thog mar snod rung du bsgrubs/ de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra se na dbab pa/ sman chen po'i bcud len/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba zhes lam gyi yan lag lnga gsungs pa de rnams dmigs pa gsal zhing khyer bde ba re nyams khrid du shin tu smin par stsal/ de nyid kyi tshe phyag chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya sna tshogs mdzad de/ mdun du brkyangs pa dang / g.yon nas g.yas phyogs su bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas lha'i phyag mtshan dang rgyan la sogs pa rnams ni tshad dbyibs kha dog sogs sku mdun de kha na phyag gis bzung du yod pa lta bu dang / lta ba'i skabs su phyag mnyam gzhag bcas te thog mar spyan 'bras nyi zla 'dra bar khra khor khor g.yo zhing / slar shangs kyi rtser zim bur gzigs te cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par mdzad la/ zhal nas kyang / kho bo la tshogs pa lta bu'i nang du yang / de dag kun la ltos pa med par brjod bral gyi nyams cung zad re 'char gyi 'dug de mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes ming gdags rung tsam yin pa 'dra zhes gsungs pa dngos su thos la/ de dag gi rgyab rten du/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam/ lam gyi cha lag 'pho ba'i yi ge mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad/

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gsung la rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris mdzad pa'i khrid yig sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams seng ge ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan grub pa'i khyu mchog grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi sdom/ grub chen nā ro ta pas mdzad pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs sogs lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i rgya bod kyi bstan bcos rab tu mang po zhig gi lung stsal zhing / de dus gsungs las/ sgrub thabs gzhan phal cher las rje btsun ma 'di la thod skam gyi do shal bshad kyang / kun mkhyen rin po che'i rlon pa'i do shal bshad pa 'di thabs mtshon byed yin pas kho bos kyang sngags 'chang chen mo'i mkha' spyod ma'i sku 'di la 'di bzhin bri ba'i bkod pa byas pa yin gsungs/ de dag ni bod gzhung rgya gzhung dang 'grel ba zhes pa de yin la/ rgya gzhung rgyud dang 'grel dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ slar yang de thams cad kyi rgyab rten du rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po'i gsung la/ de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo gnyan phul chung pa gtsug tor rgyal pos zin bris su btab pa'i rnam bshad mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang / badz+ra dharma rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa bde mchog rgyud bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed kyi steng nas/ rtsa rgyud bsdus pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i lung bshad rgyas shing mtha' chod pa dang / rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i don 'grel gzhung dang bcas bklags lung du stsal te/ dka' gnas rnams la mchan bu sogs kyi steng nas zhib bsed rgyas pa re gnang /

rtsa rgyud kyi mchan/ mu tig 'phreng ba/ nag 'bum gyi mchan sna thung ba/ rim bzhi lam slong gi mchan rnams rje btsun rtse mo zhabs kyis btab par bdag gis bla ma mus pa chen pos gsung gsungs shing / gzhan yang der skabs sa chen yab sras/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / kun mkhyen chen po/ glo bo mkhan chen pa sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyis rgyud bshad mdzad tshul dang / spyir rgyud 'chad lugs la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi 'chad lugs sogs shin tu gces shing yid la 'bab pa'i gsung bshad shin tu mtha' chod pa zhig snang yang / rgyud bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed sogs las rtogs par bya ba las 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /de lta bu'i sgo nas/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab mo rgyab chos kyi lung dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa legs par stsal bas/ de dus kyi chos nyan pa phal cher mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo 'di'i rim gnyis kyi nyams bzhes la dus rtag tu gzhol bar gyur cing / stan thon gcig tu nye snying 'bru 'bum bzla ba la sogs pa grangs dus mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin skyel ba dang / lo tshigs mang por mtshams kyi bcad rgya la 'jug pa yang mang du byung bas/ zhi ba'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag dus gcig tu dbye bar mdzad pa yin no/ /ḍā ki'i lam bzang 'od dkar 'phro ba dang / /rgyud bshad ku mud 'dzum pa mnyam du byas/ /skal bzang blo yi mun pa gsal ba dang / /mnyam du dad pa'i pad mtsho rgyas par gyur/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de dang rjes 'brel du jo bo bka' gdams pa nas brgyud pa'i myur sgrol dpal mo nyer gcig gi rjes gnang / bstod pa la sogs pa'i lung dang bcas pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū hi pa dang / ḍeṃ ki pa la sogs pa'i grub thob brgyad cu'i rjes gnang / de dag gi rtogs brjod paṇ+ḍi ta nyi ma 'od zer gyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa 'grel bcas/

sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge de dag gi rnam thar/ lo rgyus/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa la sogs pa 'di skor gyi lung yongs su rdzogs pa stsal zhing / der skabs rje nyid kyis grub chen brgyad cu'i sgrub thabs 'thus shing zlum la byin rlabs kyi dpal 'bar ba zhig mdzad de/ thub bstan lha chen gyi gling tshang so so'i bla mchod sogs kyi thog 'dzugs ja bzang po dang bcas legs par btsugs te de nyid kyi lung yang gnang / yang bdag nyid chen po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i don 'grel khog phub sbyong rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed kyi steng nas/ dpal ldan ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i bshad lung zhib cing rgyas pa'i bka' drin dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa gzhan phan kun khyab dang / dpal ldan grags pa'i thugs kyi rgya mtsho las gangs can gyi blo mun 'dzoms byed du 'ongs pa'i gzhan phan rnam gsum nyin byed dbang po'i gzi byin la co 'dri ba ltar rang gzo'i sprin tshogs rnams rmeg med du 'thor bar byed pa gzhan phan gnod 'joms kyi lung rnams stsal zhing / yang dus der gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi byin rlabs/ sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i khrid yig gi thog nas gcod do lugs kyi lung khrid/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gcod gdan thog gcig tu nyams su blang tshul ma rig mun sel gyi lung dang bcas pa legs par gnang / gzhan yang der skabs ltung bshags/ sher snying / mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i sngags 'bum/ sa lo chen po'i bka' 'bum/ rje nyid kyis sgrig par mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyin byed ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dang /

de nyid kyi thugs sras dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gnyis kyi bka' 'bum/ rje btsun bla ma rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kun mkhyen chen po'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus/ mkhan chen mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje nyid kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos rab tu mang po zhig gi ljags lung shin tu dag cing snyan pa'i gsung gis gsal bar stsal te/ bsod nams kyi nor can bgrang ba las 'das pa'i blo gros kyi yol go mang du thos pa'i zil mngar gyis phyur bur bltams par mdzad pa yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad/ gang gis zhal dkyil ut+pal bzhad pa las/ /pu pra'i me tog lan brgyar rab spros pa'i/ /rgyal kun sras bcas gdod ma'i pho brang nas/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i gtan la cis mi 'jug /skal bzang 'dus tshogs kun+ḍa'i nags klung du/ /mkha' spyod dga' ma'i lam bzang bsil zer 'bum/ /spros pas sems dpa' sbrang rtsi'i dogs pa ni/ /mthon por gcur ba'i sngon med zla dbang shar/ /gsang mtha'i snyan rgyud 'chi med lus yongs rdzogs/ /khyed thugs yangs pa'i bang mdzod du 'khyil ba/ /brtse chen drang srong skal ldan shing rta yis/ /rim pa lnga sogs rdzogs rim lugs brgya grangs/ /de tshe blo gsal 'dus pa'i tshogs kun la/ /smin grol lung gi bka' drin mtha' yas shing / /rang rang legs byas spel ba'i mchod pa'i rdzas/ /char ltar phab pa'i pha mtha' su yis shes/ /yo ga'i cha mthun rgyud rgyal gaṅgā'i chab/ /khyod thugs gtsug na zla ba'i ral pa nas/ /blo gsal chu gter dbus su thigs pa na/ /mkhas mang ma dros rgya mtsho gsar du 'khyil/ /de nas lo de'i dbyar thog thub bstan yangs pa can gyi dkar khra gnyis kyi slob dpon pa sogs gzhi byes kyi bshes gnyen du ma zhig la/

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid dang / dpal rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzongs ma'i khrid gnyis so so'i rgyab lung dang bcas pa mang po zhig gi bka' drin stsal/ de'i ston rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs gzhi byes kyi bla ma slob dpon sogs bshes gnyen brgya phrag brgal ba la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum so so'i dbang rnams rim pa bzhin sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ thog mar bde mchog nag po lugs kyi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas shing mtha' chod pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid dang bcas pa dang / rdzogs rim nag po rim bzhi dang / dpyid thig gi khrid rnams smin rgyas su gnang nas/ de dag gi rgyab chos lung gi bskor la/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog rgyud 'debs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum nyams su blang tshul dang / bskyed rim rnam bshad bde chen thigs 'phreng / rje bzang po dpal bas mdzad pa'i nag po bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad chen mo dang / dpyid thig gi khrid yig kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i rim bzhi'i khrid yig rje sa skya pa chen po'i rim bzhi lam slong / grub chen nag po spyod pa'i rdo rjes bkral ba'i nag po gzhung drug sogs shin tu mtha' chod pa rgyas bshad du stsal/ der rjes grub pa'i slob dpon chen po lū hi pa'i lugs kyi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa dang dmigs khrid/ rdzogs rim bsdu ba gsum pa'i khrid/ bzang po dpal bas mdzad pa'i rnam bshad/ lū hi pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs kyi 'grel pa/ phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga lag pa'i mchod pa/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ste lū hi pa'i smad lngar grags pa'i lung dang bcas pa dang / de nyid kyi mtshams nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi bskyed rim dang /

rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa'i khrid/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lū dril gnyis kyi sgrub thabs/ lū nag dril gsum ka'i rnam bshad/ bde mchog chos 'byung chen mo bzang po dpal bas mdzad pa'i dril bu lugs kyi rnam bshad/ grub chen de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lus dkyil gyi mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog rim lnga ste/ dril bu gzhung gsum gyi lung dang bcas pa sogs mdor na 'khor lo bde mchog lugs gsum gyi rgyu lam gyi dbang / bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ rgyab rten gyi lung rnams tshang la ma nor bar stsol ba mdzad de/ nyid kyi gsung las/ chos gang la yang / bla mas kyang dbu zhabs sgrigs nas bshad/ slob mas kyang don gnyer chen pos de bzhin nyan na bstan pa mnal ma zhig 'ong ba yin te zhes yang yang gsung ba de rang nyid kyi phyag bzhes la theb par mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i skabs nam mkha' shin tu dwangs ba las me tog char zim rgyun ma chad par babs shing / gsung las kyang snga sor rje mus pa chen po las nged kyis 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi dbang nos pa'i tshe/ bar snang 'ja' 'od kyi drwa bas khyab pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar can mang du byung / bdag gi bla ma mus pa chen po de spyir mdo sngags mtha' dag la thos bsam phyin ci ma log pa mthar phyin zhing / khyad par lugs 'di la bde mchog rlon pa rang yin zhes gsung ba sogs bsngags brjod dpag tu med pa dang / phyag thugs khar thal mo sbyar te skyabs su mchi zhes gus pa'i tshul ci yang zhig mdzad de/ de lta bu'i sgo nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i zab lam 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal sngon med gsar du phye bas/ thar 'dod sbrang rtsi can kun gyi re ba yid bzhin du rdzogs te/ bsam sgom gyi gshog rtsal ci nus su bskyod nas legs bshad kyi mgrin glu dar dir phyogs kun tu sgrog cing /

rje btsun chen po 'di nyid kyang gdan sa chen po 'di chos 'di rnams kyi 'byung khungs rang du snang ba la skabs 'ga' zhig tu yid srub kyis byed pas chos kyi ming tsam yang mi grags pa'i tshod gcig byung 'dug kyang / bla ma dang chos skyong gi thugs rjes 'di lta bu'i 'chad nyan gegs med grub pa rang re thams cad skal ba bzang zhes gsungs shing shin tu dges par gyur to/ /gzhan yang de dag dang rgyun chags su grub thob g.ya' bzang pa nas brgyud pa'i bza' bsrung gi u pa de sha'i yig lung dang / sa skya pa'i yab chos nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi man ngag gi lung / de dag la changs bu 'bul tshul gyi gdams pa rnams stsal ba sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i chos tshul de rnams gnang zin 'phral/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gtsug lag zung 'brel dang bcas pa la rnam dpyod kyi mthu grub cing mkhas pa'i bgyi ba rnam pa gsum la rang dbang du mdzad pa'i shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la thogs pa med pa byang nas bdag po rin po ches gsol ba btab pa'i ngor gzhi byes kyi skal ldan mang po zhig la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'brus bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo cha lag dang bcas pa bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyis tshogs bshad tshar bcu pa bka' drin chen pos stsol bar mdzad de/ de dus lam gyi rnal 'byor 'chag med nyams su len pa'i dam bca' 'bul mi yang mang dag byung ngo / /don de dag la 'di skad/ slar yang mkha' 'gro'i bskyed rdzogs sprin gyis bcud/ /khro bcu'i srung 'khor rdo rje gzegs mar bcas/ /skal ldan 'dzin mar phabs tshe sbyang bsgyur mtsho/ /gang zhig bdag ltas sa 'dzin phye mar snyil/ /zla ba'i thod can lugs gsum gdams pa'i nor/ /'dod dgur spungs te ris med gdul bya yis/ snod bcud tha mal dngos dang cig shos kyi/ /snang gzhan dbul ba'i 'jigs pa ring du bskrad/ /bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal gdams mtho ris rlung /

/gang gi rnam dpyod mdza' bo'i ltor skyil nas/ /'gro blo'i sa 'og sprul tshe slob ma yis/ /dug can bu rnams sgrib bral thar par song / /de nas rnam rgyal zhes pa chu mo sbrul gyi lo dam pa 'di nyid dgung gi bgrang gzhi lnga bcu rtsa bdun du phebs pa na/ mdo khams nas a li chos rje grwa bu slob mang po dang bcas 'jam dbyangs bla ma 'di nyid kyi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal ba dang / gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung bar bcas 'byor/ de skabs chos sde chen por mang ja'i bsnyen bkur dang ja gos dar la sogs pa'i gral 'gyed mang po yang btang / bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid du 'bul snod rgya chen po bsgrubs shing shin tu gus par gyur/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis kyang chos dang zang zing gi dngos pos re ba'i yol go bskangs/ dgun thog der gtsang grom pa rgyang nas mkhas pa chen po mang thos klu grub rgya mtsho'i sku drin che ba'i bla ma mkhan chen blo gros rnam rgyal gyi rje dbon rin po che mang thos grags pa rnam rgyal/ gdan sa chen po 'dir 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nas brgyud pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom rgyun zhig nges par dgos rgyur snang ba/ spel ba'i mkhan po'i 'os rigs su khyed che ba 'dug pas/ bstan pa som la myur bar spyon cig pa'i bka'i spring yig gser gyi shing rtas legs par drangs te/ dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying ma'i dri'i gtsang khang mchog tu chos kyi rje de nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad de/ dge 'dun grangs tshang bas cho ga rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ chos grwa lho byang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang por/ kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī bha drwa nas/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi thub pa chen po 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la legs par brgyud pa'i yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par 'bogs pa'i mthun pa'i cha rkyen bzang pos nye bar sbyar te/

dkar phyogs kyi lha klu sa gsum na gnas pa thams cad dga' ba'i zlos gar la ngoms pa med par rtser bcug go /'di ni sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i ring lugs la gcig tu dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed kyi lhag bsam ston zla ltar dkar ba sku tshe'i phreng bar goms pa'i mtshon byed yang dag pa ste/ de yang bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'di nyid mkhas dbang nā ga dzu nar 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom rgyun de nyid thugs bskyed rmad du byung bas bzhes nas/ dpal gnyan yod byar gshong dang / grags chen sogs su chos rje 'ga' rong pa dang / 'brug pa'i dbu che chos rje spos skya ba sogs bla ma dang / blo gsal mang po la rgya cher spel te/ bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i ngur smrig ste/ /bgrang bar mi bzod mkhan bu'i cho ga bgyis/ /'di tsam gyis kyang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i/ /tshul khrims dri yis phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces smon lam yang mdzad pa de nyid legs par smin pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu bla na med pa'o/ /de nas lo de'i 'jug gdug pa can 'ga' zhig gis byed pa'i rkyen gyis/ mchod yon nas gling kha dgon par snyad rtsod cung zad byung skabs/ rje 'di'i gsung las/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i dbang gis bstan la 'phel 'grib byung ba rgyal bas gsungs/ zhes gsungs pa'i lung don du sleb pa yin 'dug cing / 'di dag 'byung ba yang snga sor rgyal ba mus pa chen po de nyid kyis ma 'ongs pa na gnas tshul 'di bzhin 'byung ba sgrib med du gzigs pas/ lung bstan gnyer dam gyi tshul du zhabs drung gi dgon pa 'di blos ma btang na 'u gnyis la dam tshig bsel mi yong / blos btang na dam tshig gi bsel du 'gro bas thugs blos ma btang zhig ces sogs thugs dkyil nas gzhal ba'i bslab bya nan tan du gnang ba thog tu khel byung ba nas/

blos btang na dam tshig gi bsel du yang 'gro ba yod pas stobs gang thon bya dgos gsungs/ mkhan rin po che bsed bkrol gnas tshul 'bul bar gnang skyes rgya chen po bcas lha sar rdzongs ltar gnang / de skabs rje nyid kyi mtshan lam du/ mkhan rin po che de chos skyong gi rnams sprul mang pos bskor te byon pa zhig byung gsungs nas/ zhu don 'di dga' rab yong 'dug cing / rang re kun 'di phyi thams cad du rje btsun gong mas thugs rje mi gtong nges su 'dug gsung ba sogs dngos su thos la/ de yang bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ bsod nams shugs kyis don 'grub pa/ /nyi ma'i 'od bzhin ltos pa med/ /'bad pa'i shugs kyis don grub pa/ /mar me'i 'od bzhin kun la bltos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /dam pa 'di nyid kyi thugs rje dang chos skyong rnams kyi 'phrin las 'bad med du sgrub cing / mkhan rin po che nas zhu sbyar legs pa sogs kyi mthu las/ zla ba re zhig gzas zin yang / /de ma thag tu grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gling kha dgon pa slar yang rje rang nyid kyi phyag tu 'byor ste bstan pa rin po che nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /smras pa/ de tshe blo gsal 'dus pa'i tshogs kun gyi/ /rang rang 'byor dang bstun pa'i mchod sprin gyis/ /dam pa gang gi spyan sngar rtag mchod cing / /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i rgyal rnga srid rtse brgal/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /yang lo de'i dpyid thog tsam nas bzung rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid sku khams cung zad ma bde ba dang / khyad par phyag sor shin tu ma bde ba'i tshul bstan te/ 'di lo bka' chos 'chad nyan sogs kyang rgya cher ma gnang zhing / dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs la yang thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid la bka' stsal phebs te/ rdo rje phur pa'i sa chog nas gtor skyong gi bar 'jam dbyangs nyid kyi rkang bzhes kho na mdzad/

'di skabs rje'i gsung las/ 'di lo chos 'chad nyan sogs kyang mang po ma thub cing dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs la yang 'gro thub pa zhig ma byung pas sems mdzangs kyang bya thabs ma mchis zhes gsungs pa ni sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i bka' stsal ste/ de yang sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid ston pa'i 'khor gyi gtso bo mau'u 'gal gyi bus skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zlos gar du nges par byed pa'i mtshan ma yang dag pa yin te/ rje'i gsung las/ bsam yas chos skyong gi nged mau'u 'gal gyi bu'i skye ba yin zer ba ltar na/ mau'u 'gal gyi bus yan lag rnams gcer bu pa dbyug thogs rnams kyis dum bur bcom nas/ gnas brtan sha ri'i bus chos gos kyis g.yogs te 'khyer nas 'byon dgos pa byung zhing / gzhan yang sku tshe mang por de 'dra ba'i lus 'tsher myong dgos byung 'dug de yang tshe rabs gzhan zhig la rang gi pha ma gnyis nyin mo dga' mgur rol ba mthong nas ma dad ste/ yan lag 'jom par bya ba khyed lta bu'i pha ma dang mi 'phrad par gyur cig ces pha ma la 'phyar kha byas pa'i 'bras bu yin par bshad/ de yang mkhas dbang klu sgrub rgya mtshos mdo las gsungs pa'i brjod bya rnams tshigs bcad du sdom par mdzad pa las/ pha mar tshig rtsub smras pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog brnyes mau'u 'gal bu de yang / /mu stegs tshogs kyis yan lag bcom nas kyang / /sku tshe'i 'du byed bor ba'i rnam thar gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pa des na/ nged kyi ser mo na ba 'di yang las de'i rnam smin gyi l+h+wam ma yin par snang / zhes yang yang gsung ba dngos su thos pas so/ /yang de dus skabs zhig ḍā ki'i gtso mo mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal dngos sum du gzigs pas/ slad nas gzigs snang ngo mtshar can de nyid kyi bkod pa ri mor 'khod par mdzad de/ tshes bcu mchod pa'i skabs sogs bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin gsal 'debs kyi dmigs rten du 'grem par mdzad pa 'di yin no/

/de nas 'bras ldan gyi dus ston gsar pa sngon du gyur pa na/ lha klu mi gsum gyi rin po che sna bco lnga spungs pa la/ bi shwa karmas sgyu 'phrul gyis bzhengs pa skabs gsum dbang po'i yon gyi bdag po byas te/ rgyal ba nyid kyis shis pa'i me tog gsar pa jo bo shākya mu ne dang mnyam du gtor ba'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba thub pa 'od zer 'gyed dang lung bstan sgrol ma la sogs pa sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan ye shes kyi 'khor lo bzhugs nges pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sngon med gsar du 'byor pa rnams mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa dang bcas rje nyid kyi gzim chung du tshogs kyi zhing dam par bzhugs pa las/ 'di thams cad gdan sa chen po 'di nyid las gzhan du nam yang 'khyar ba mi 'os pa na 'di rnams phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang zur pa zhig ched du gtad nas bzhengs dgos par 'dug snyam pa'i thugs dgongs bzang po rgyun chags su yod pa'i skabs shig nyid kyi mtshan lam du mi zhig gis gser gyi za ma tog shin tu mdzes shing 'od 'bar ba zhig phul nas/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung bzhugs pa'i gtsang khang mdzad du gsol zhes zhu ba zhig byung bas/ 'od gsal las bzhengs pa'i tshe rmi lam shin tu bzang gtsug lag khang nyes skyon med par mthar phyin pa zhig 'ong ba 'dug snyam pa 'khrungs shing / thugs dges spro chen pos las kyi dbu btsugs te/ las mi rnams la yang zhabs drung du bzhugs gral ja chang ston mo dang bcas zhal lta legs par gnang bas thams cad gus shing mgu ste las la 'grus ston pas/ phyi'i spen bad nang gi rkyang nul dang bcas pa dgun stod tshun la myur bar grub/ de nas rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta'i lo rje nyid dgung grangs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad du phebs pa ba san+ta'i dus kyi lang tsho dar bar gyur pa na/ skya ser ris su ma bcad pa skye bo grangs med pa zhig la sbyin gtong gi dga' ston rgya chen po zhig kyang stsal/

gtsug lag khang nang gi zhal ba rnams grub stun ka gdung sogs shing brtsegs kyi tshon rtsi dang / ldebs bris kyi bkod pa ches phul du byung ba mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa 'di rnams snang ste/ de yang byang ngos kyi steng la thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa dang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis rnams bzhugs shing / rten khri'i rgyab byin la mkha' spyod dbang mo/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs mgon po 'od dpag med rnams kyi snang brnyan stong phrag la nye ba re/ bar mtshams su bla sku mang pos brgyan pa dang / shar ldebs la rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos gsung ngag rin po che bla ma brgyud rim/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhing mchog bde ba can gyi bkod pa/ de'i steng na rdo rje 'chang yab sras gsum 'od khyim du bzhugs pa'i nye skor na/ bdag nyid chen po de nyid rdo rje'i khri las skad cig kyang ma g.yos bzhin du/ dag zhing gzhan du yang sprul ba 'gyed pas mtshon byed sprin 'phreng gi sne phyag gis bzung ba'i bkod pa dang / lho'i ldebs bris la mgon po tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang brgyud dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i brgyud pa/ pad+ma ka ra jo 'brom yab sras bcas pa dang / chu lha'i ngos kyi ldebs bris la gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje chos skor dang / kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang brgyud rnams gtso bor bzhugs pa'i gseb tshags su rje nyid sngags 'chang yab sras mus chen rnams 'bral med kyi mtshon don mang po/ gzhan yang bde dges gsang gsum/ tshe lha du ma sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor gur zhal rnam gnyis sogs chos srung mang po dang / dmar po skor gsum sogs nor sbyin dbang bsdud kyi lha rigs mtha' yas pa dang / gdung ma'i nang ldebs kyi ngos la rgyal dbang 'od dpag med kyi snang brnyan mang po/ phyir logs la lañcha'i tshe gzungs gser shog ma 'ba' zhig sked ris la 'chi med dpal mo'i gzungs ring lha yig tu bris pa ngo mtshar ba/

gzhan yang ka ba bre phul/ gzhu ring thung bad 'bur steng logs sogs thams cad tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gi rnam par bkra zhing / mthong na mi mthun pa med pa mig dang snying 'phrog pa/ mtho ris kyi thems skas su gyur pa 'di nyid dbyar thog der shin tu legs par mthar phyin ste/ gzim chung sngar yod kyi rten khyad par can rnams mchod pa'i phung po dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lta bu bkod pa'i khyad par yid du 'ong ba tshad med pa dang bcas gral gyi 'phreng mdzes mtshar du mngar ba mdzad de/ de yang rten 'brel gyi gtso bor sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyin byed kun dga' rin chen gyi sku brnyan/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / dam pa 'di nyid kyi phyag gnas brgya tshar ma sogs gnang ba'i sku 'dra rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgos 'dod kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa nyid bzhugs te/ de'i g.yas g.yon phyogs su drug pa rdo rje 'chang nas/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gi sku brnyan so so'i phyag bzo dang phyag gnas bzhugs pa rnams dang / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i snang brnyan byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba gsol ba btab na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa 'di rnams mchod pa'i bye brag kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lta bu phyur bur bltams te bzhugs pa'i mtshan la yang bla ma lha khang mthong ba don ldan nam/ gzhan las khyad par phul du byung bas 'phags pa zhes gsol bar mdzad do/ /de dang 'dabs 'byor bar mnyam du bzhengs pa'i mgon khang khyad par can na rten gyi gtso bo rje btsun sa skya pa la sku dang chos kyi bka' babs bzhi bzhugs pa'i sku'i bka' babs kyi nang mtshan pu hrang lo tsā ba'i bla chen kun dga' snying po la dges bzhin du gnang ba bram ze mchog sred kyi pur sol las rang byon du 'khrungs pa shing mgon yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang /

ba ri lo tsā ba nas brtse ba chen po la babs pa ri bo ma la ya'i rtser rang byon du byon pa'i rdo mgon yid bzhin gyi nor bu gtso bor bzhugs pa'i g.yas g.yon steng 'og rnams su rgya bod kyi paṇa grub mang po'i thugs dam gyi rten dang phyag bzo phyag bris sogs las bskrun pa'i sku'i rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs shing / phyogs bzhi'i ldebs rnams la dpal gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad gtso bor gyur pa'i chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi sku brnyan bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig dang / bla ma gong ma'i gzigs snang gi bkod pa so sor zhal yig bcas pa bri bar mdzad/ de rnams kyi drung na gtor tshogs lhun po la 'gran pa nam mkha' rgyang bu drag po'i nyer spyod dang bcas pa/ sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can la dam can rdor legs kyis skad cig gcig la gzhis chen du brdungs nas phul ba'i lcags kyi rdo rje zhal byang gis brgyan pa dang / gzhan yang rdo rje dang phur pa gter ma ngo mtshar can grangs las 'das pa rnams dang / sa lo chen po'i sgrub rnga byin rlabs can/ 'phags pa dang theg chen rin po che'i dbang rdzas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bdag chen rgya gar ba dang sngags 'chang chen po'i phur bzlog gnang dus kyi karta ri sogs spyan gzigs kyi tshogs dbyar dus kyi sprin phung ltar 'thib pa shin tu gzi brjid che zhing ngo mtshar ba 'di rnams rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis lta bas mi ngoms shing / gdug pa can dag gi mthong ba tsam gyi tsit+ta lkog mar 'dren pa 'di dag gsar du bskrun pa mdzad de mtshan la yang mgon khang bdud las rnam rgyal lam/ gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhes gsol bar mdzad/ de gnyis kar thun mong du sgo khang sgo glegs g.yab dang bcas pa tshon rtsi dang gser shog phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa/ steng du rgyal mtshan gser 'bru dang rnga thug du ma/ logs la dril bu'i 'phreng ba dri bza'i glu dbyangs lta bu'i sgra skad 'byin pa sogs brgya byin gyi khang bzang rnam par rgyal byed kyang spa skong bar byed pa 'di dag bzhengs te/

rgyud sde rin po che nas gsungs pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga smin rgyas su stsol bar mdzad do/ /de dag thun mong ba tsam brjod pa yin gyi rgyas par ni rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag so so las rtogs par bya'o/ /lo de'i dbyar 'bras spungs nas sprul pa'i sku thams cad mkhyen pa mchod yon rnams gzhis kha chen po bsam 'grub rtser phebs/ de skabs bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi bstan pa spyi bye brag gi 'phel rgyas dang / khyad par thams cad mkhyen pa nyid snga sor ma mjal ba sogs kyi btab nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te gzhis ka rtser phebs/ mchod yon so so nas kyang phebs bsu zhabs tog sogs phul du phyin pa mdzad/ de nas mjal phrad kyi tshe so so nas mjal ma thag tu ring nas 'grogs pa'i dga' 'dun gyi grogs ltar dag snang shin tu che bar bcas phan tshun bag phebs kyi gsung gleng ci yang zhig gnang rjes/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi mchod yon so sor gnang skyes rgya dpangs shin tu che ba zhig stsal zhing / mchod yon nas kyang bzhugs gral gyi dga' ston zab cing rgya che ba ri mtsho ltar spungs shing / 'bul nod kyang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal/ dar gos kyi yug ring mang po dang / gzhan yang rin po che'i rigs sogs dngos gtsang zhing grangs mang ba rnam thos sras kyi mdzod kha phye ba lta bu'i 'dod yon gyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa bsnyen cing bkur te shin tu thugs nang gtsang bar gyur/ de skabs nyin gcig rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang dben zhing lhod par mjal 'dzoms gnang skabs sprul pa'i sku des/ rje btsun dam pa 'di la mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa las brtsams te 'bel gtam gyi bka' mchid rang nyid kyis ji tsam spob pa zhig dri bar mdzad pa na/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis dag gsal snyan pa'i gsung gis/ chos 'di'i ngo bo ni 'di rnams lags/ dbye ba ni 'di tsam mchis/ brgyud pa ni 'di las 'ongs/

yul dus ni 'di rnams su dar/ bshad tshul ni 'di 'dra zhig bdog nyams su ni 'di ltar du len/ zhes sogs rdo rje tshig mang po zhig 'doms par mdzad pas/ sprul pa'i sku de nyid thugs dag snang shin tu che ba dang bcas bstod bskur bsngags gsum gyi sgo nas snyan pa'i gdugs dkar phyogs kun tu bskor bar mdzad cing / slar dbus su phebs nas kyang dam pa 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpal gshin rje gshed kyi chos byung 'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed sogs gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig spyan lam du smin pas kyang thugs song ste snyan tshig gi 'phreng bas spud pa'i bsngags brjod dpyid kyi pho nya ngo mtshar can zhig kyang bsngags par mdzad do/ /de khar zhag bdun tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon/ dpon rigs che gra/ skye ser gyi tshogs shin tu mang bas phyag dbang zhu ba bcas 'bul nod rgya chen po phul/ dam pa 'dis kyang so sor 'dod chos dang re ba'i 'bras bu lan brgyar smin grub tu stsal rjes chibs thog khyon par mdzad de snar thang dang / gangs can sogs su phebs/ de dag gang phebs su rnyed bkur dang 'bul nod stobs mi ni bgrang ba las 'das/ de nas rang zhabs kyi skye bo dpag tu med pas glu gzhas dang / 'dra 'dri chos rdzong khams gsum zil gnon gyi bla ma dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams kyis ser 'phreng gi bkod pa phul du byung ba dang bcas gdan sa bar pa dge sdings chos kyi pho brang du phebs/ der zhag 'ga' bzhugs ring 'dra 'dri mgon khang dang / khyad par bdag chen rgya gar ba'i thugs dam gyi mgon po lcam dral ye shes pa dngos su bzhugs pa'i drung du bskang ba dang ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar du sde bstan pa gdung brgyud bcas par 'phrin bcol yang dag pa mdzad/ der 'dus kyi skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyang rang rang gi re ba'i 'bras bu phyur bur bltams pa'i dga' zhing mgu ba'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzad do/

/de nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te skyis stod du phebs/ nang so rnams kyis rnyed bkur phun sum tshogs par mdzad de/ rim gyis gdan sa chen por phebs nye ba na/ phebs bsu ser 'phreng gi bkod pa gzab spros ches che ba dang bcas gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid du rdo'i sku shin tu 'od 'phro ba dang bcas phebs pa yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad/ thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /gtsug tor bsnyen rdzogs nor bu tog gi blo/ /mang thos grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas/ /legs spyad 'dod dgu'i dga' char dus der phab/ /rtag tu mi dge'i las la byol nyog tu/ /bag med dga' mgur spyod pa'i 'gro mang la/ /blang dor ston phyir sgrib bral rgyal ba yang / /bsnyun gyis rtses pa'i tshul de bden lags drangs/ /skyo shas nges 'byung bskyed byed 'di skad du/ /duḥkhas khur 'di sngon rabs pha ma gnyis/ /gnyis sbyor bde bar rol la rting pa'i las/ /las byung rnam smin lhag mar nges zhes gsungs/ /gsung 'di nyan thos chen po mau'u 'gal bu/ /bu ram shing pa'i 'khor gyi gtso de ni/ /nyid kyi skye ba'i gar du yid ches blo/ /shes ldan gang dag yid ches cis mi skye/ /de tshe mkha' spyod dga' ma'i grong khyer nas/ /de bzhin gshegs kun yum mchog ḍā ki'i dbang / /de nyid 'dzum zhal dngos su bstan ma thag /de dang gnyis med bde chen dpa' bor gyur/ /gang gis legs byas bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /srub pa'i phun tshogs sbyor ba las/ /lha dang bla ma chos srung gi /bsti gnas nyi zla zung 'di shar/ /de dag kun tu kun bzang rnam 'phrul gyis/ /mchod sprin dbus na dbus 'gyur bstan pa'i gtso/ /thub dbang mchog sogs mchog gsum rten gyi tshogs/ /grangs yas byin rlabs byin za 'bar zhing bzhugs/ /de yi 'dab na dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang / /dbus su dpal ldan bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/

/'khor dang pho nya mang po khro zhing rab 'du ba'i/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can 'jig rten 'di na khyab/ /de nas myos byed ces pa shing mo lug gi lo rje nyid dgung gi bgrang gzhi lnga bcu rtsa dgur phebs pa na/ snga sor yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can gyis bka' bzhin rigs 'dzin lha khang gi 'og tshom chen mor sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can dang / rje btsun bla ma rang nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gur lcam dral gyi 'cham sku ngo mtshar can bzhi mgon khang nub nas gdan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol/ byang nub kyi ldebs logs steng 'og gi cha la sa lo chen pos gsar bzhengs thugs dam ma'i lam 'bras brgyud pa sogs bla ma yid dam chos skyong gi sku brnyan mang po mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas/ yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi dgongs pa zab mo yongs su bskong bar mdzad/ lo de'i dgun byang nas bdag po rin po che dang rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i rigs dang chos kyi sras rje dbon sangs rgyas rab brtan sogs mus dang bzlog phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon grwa pa mang po dang / chos grwa phan tshun gyi bla slob 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa'i skal ldan mang po zhig la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor gyi cha lag chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i byin rlabs gzhan la med pa'i khyad par can de dang / bde kye gsang gsum sogs bla med phal cher gyi dbang khrid rjes gnang lung la sogs pa mang po zhig stsal/ de nas dpyid kyi dpal mo'i 'dzum zhal gsar du bstan pa na/ da lta'i ngor mkhan po bsod nams rgya mtsho ba'i zhabs de dus dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi zur 'chad mdzad pa'i ngang nas zhal dkyil mjal ba dang zab chos mang po zhig gsol btab zhu bar bcas 'byor pa'i ngor/ gzhis byes kyi dge 'dun skal ba dang ldan pa sum brgya bskor la zung 'jug dges pa rdo rje rgyud gsum gyi bshad ka sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad de/

de yang thog mar rje nyid kyis 'jam dbyangs sku mched la rtsa rgyud 'phags mchan dang bcas pa'i bshad lung gsan pa'i brgyud rim/ rje nags dgon pa chen po las rtsa rgyud/ de'i 'grel pa dag ldan/ de'i gsal byed dag ldan go sla dang bcas pa/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags las/ rgyud gsum ka so so'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan pa'i brgyud 'debs tshan pa gsum gyi kha skong dang bcas pa'i rgyud 'debs kun khyab mar grags pa rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung gnang nas/ dpon slob kun gyis snyan zhing brjid pa'i gdangs kyi nga ros gsol ba 'debs pa mdzad cing / brgyud 'debs 'di e wam̐ pas/ sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i brgyud 'debs dpal ldan brtan g.yo ma la thugs song nas/ de la dpe mdzad de brtsam pa yin pas shin tu legs gsungs/ thugs rtsis dpe med gnang / de nas de lta bu'i brgyud pa la nye brgyud dang ring brgyud gnyis las/ ring brgyud ni mngon par rtogs pa rin po che ljon shing las/ rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhes sogs brgyud kyang man ngag gi bshad pa'i brgyud rim dang / yang ljon shing las/ a la la dang dpal ldan nags khrod gar+bha ri/ /zhes sogs rgyud don yan lag lnga'i dpe dang sbyar te 'grel pa'i steng nas rgyas par 'chad pa 'grel pa lugs kyi brgyud pa smos nas/ de ltar bka' srol gnyis 'dus kyi chu bo chen po 'brog mi lo tsā ba nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs tshul sogs brgyud pa'i bshad pa rgya cher mdzad nas/ de dang 'grel bar ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge'i lung yang stsal/ de nas bshad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba la/ rnam gzhag mtshan gyi don dang bshad thabs dang / /mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya tshul bzhi yin/ /zhes pa ltar bzhi po thams cad la gsung bshad shin tu rgyas zhing zhib par snang ste/

'jug tu don bsdus tshigs bcad re 'grems pa mdzad/ de dag gi rgyab rten du rje btsun sku mched kyi spyi rnam dang / ljon shing / glo mkhan chen pa'i gsung la sa los zin bris mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro'i yig sna gnyis/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsal rgyan dang / mdzes rgyan gyi lung rnams gnang ste dpon slob thams cad brel ba ches pas ha cang yun ring ba 'gor na mi 'ong ba 'dug gzhan ma sbyor dngos kun la zin thun re btang na snyam pa yod gsungs/ 'di ni rje nyid spyir mdo sngags yongs rdzogs/ khyad par lta ba rim pa can gyi skabs dang bstun pas grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam gzhag la shin tu mkhas pas 'jigs med seṅge'i nga ro ltar snang ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtshos/ rang re sa skya pa'i phyag srol sngon 'gro tshul bzhi dang rgyud kyi dngos gzhi gnyis nges par dgos pas thog mar bshad bya'i rgyud/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag des ji ltar 'chad tshul gsum tshang ba ni rgyud sde spyi rnam yin pas de'i zin thun btang / de rjes rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni mngon rtogs ljon shing yin pas de'i zin thun btang / 'di rnams kyi zin thun gtong ba la spyir mdo sngags zung 'jug khyad par grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i rnam gzhag legs par phyed pa'i rnam dpyod dang ldan pa zhig ma byung na mgrin pa thung hril 'gro bas/ gzhan gyi rtsam chos la klog sgrogs re ba tsam las mi 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa yin gsungs te/ lta ba rim pa can gyi gsung bshad gnang ba'i skabs su/ ljon shing nyid dang rje ngor chen gyi gong ma'i dgongs rgyan/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan rnams dang sbyor bar mdzad cing / gzhan yang 'dul ba/ mngon pa gong 'og phar phyin dbu ma rnams kyi gzhung chen tha dad so so'i ṭīk+ka spyi don rnams nas rgyas bshad kha skong bar mdzad de zhib cing mtha' chod pa sems thog tu smin pa zhig stsal bas/

sku tshe hril por 'di kho na la sbyangs pa mdzad 'dug snyam pa'i mdo phyogs la sbyangs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po kun kyang 'di lta bu e ma mtshar 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin nges su 'dug snyam pa'i dad pa rang dbang med par bskyed par mdzad cing / rgyud gsum so so'i dngos gzhi'i gsung bshad kyi skabs/ rtsa rgyud la dag ldan dang / de'i gsal byed dag ldan go sla shar pa ye rgyal gyis mdzad pa dang / theg chen pa'i dag ldan go sla rnams kyi steng nas shin tu zhib pa dang / sam+pu ṭi la gnad kyi gsal byed dang / rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi ṭīk+ka'i steng nas zab bshad dang / rdo rje gur la gur rgyan dang / lu phu ba chos rje nam mkha' smon lam gyis mdzad pa'i ṭīk+ka'i steng nas rgyas bshad don bsdus sogs zhib tu gnang zhing / de dag gi rgyab rten du yig cha rnying ma so so'i lung dang / rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tshul bzhi sngon 'gro'i rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis rkyang pa'i don 'grel khog phub rgyud 'grel sgo brgya'i lde mig dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa gnang dus zin bris su gnang ba'i tshul bzhi sngon 'gro'i rgyud gsum ka'i don 'grel khog phub/ yang tshul bzhi rgyas bshad dang bcas pa'i brtag gnyis kyi 'bru 'grel chen mo rnams kyi lung bshad sbags mar stsal te/ de skabs der 'dus kyi slob ma'i tshogs rnams sa skya pa'i yab chos rgyud gsum la blo gros kyi mig spu rab tu phye nas/ legs bshad smra ba'i 'jigs med kyi spobs pa seṅge'i nga ro ltar sgrog nus pa'i dga' ston spel te/ dpal sa skyar bstan pa'i 'byung khungs su rgyud gsum gyi bstan pa'i me ro rmang nas bslangs te/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs par mdzad pa yin no/ /lo de'i ston phyogs nas byon pa'i don gnyer du ma dang /

'dir bzhugs rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug lcam sring / mkhan rin po che 'jam dpa'i dbyangs mai tri dh+ya na sa mu drwa/ byang nas bdag po rin po che bla ma'i drung / ngam ring mkhan rin po che klu sgrub dar rgyas/ chos 'khor lhun po nas mkhan rin po che sangs rgyas shes rab/ bzang ldan slob dpon pa chen po byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ gdan sa'i chos las pa gnyis sogs chos nyan pa brgya phrag lhag tsam la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi rim lnga'i khrid 'gos lugs gtsang ma sogs de skor gyi chos tshul rgya che ba zhig stsol bar mdzad pa dang / de dang 'grel bar gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud bshad sngags 'chang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus chos 'byung snga rtsom phyi rtsom gnyis kyi steng nas gsung bshad/ 'di skor la mkho ba'i rgya gzhung bod gzhung nyid kyi mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel khog phub sogs ljags lung gi tshogs shin tu zhib pa lus pa med pa stsal te/ de dus kyi slob ma rnams gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa'i dgongs don la blo gros kyi snang ba rab tu rgyas pa'i dga' ston stsol bar mdzad cing / gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi bstan pa nam lang pa la nyin byed 'od kyis spa ba ltar ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa yin no// //de nas gdong ngan zhes pa me pho sprel lo rje nyid dgung gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag drug tu phebs pa na/ sngar gyi slob tshogs de rnams dang / ngor mkhan rin po che bsod nams rgya mtsho ba sogs gsar du 'dus pa mang po la dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rjes gnang / gsang khrid/ de dag gi rgyab rten lung gi tshogs ma tshang ba med pa song rjes/ rje tshar pa'i ha la nag po'i be'u bum dang / de nyid kyi kha skong / dam pa nyid kyis sgrig par mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang bzhin gyi lung slob ma rags bsdus zhig la stsal zhing /

bka' las kyang / 'di chig brgyud kho na yin kyang chos skyong la gnang ba zhus nas bstan pa bsam pa'i khyed rnams la byas pa yin pas bstan pa snying khong du bcang ba gal che gsungs so/ /don de dag la 'di skad/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum mchog gtso/ /bdag med ye shes ḍā ki'i zhal sgo las/ /smin byed bdud rtsi mchog gi ro dngar po/ /dngos su gsol ba dpal ldan bi rū pa/ 1 /gos dkar lcang lo'i skur bstan sa skya pa'i/ /bka' srol dri med dges rdor rgyud gsum gyis/ /tshul bzhi sngon 'gro'i bshad ka zla med pa/ /rgyas par stsal bas ljongs 'di dkar por byas/ 2 /pha rgyud gtso bo dpal ldan 'dus pa yis/ /rgyud dang man ngag sbrel ba'i legs bshad kyi/ /sngon med nyi ma gsar pa 'di shar bas/ /blo gsal blo yi pad+mo ches cher rgyas/ 3 /gzhan yang bstan srung dbang po zhal bzhi pa'i/ /dkon zhing gnyan pa'i rjes gnang khrid man ngag /yig skor bcas pa'i zab chos sprin dbyangs kyis/ /dga' ston mdong ldan tshogs la spel 'di mtshar/ 4 /lha brgyas thor cog ngo mtshar nor bu'i khrir/ /zhabs sen dbyig gi khu ba ngal 'tsho ba'i/ /'gro mang kun dga'i byed po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /slar yang bsod nams mgron du 'dir spyon cig /de nas lo de'i 'bras ston gyi dus gsar du shar ba na sems can spyi'i las kyi sgra gcan mthu rtas pa'i dbang gis lho bod shin tu zir shing rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dngos su myong bas shin tu nyams nga ba'i tshe/ de rnams mgrin gcig tu sdug bsngal gyi phung po zad mi shes pa 'di lta bu la/ dpal ldan sa skya nas bdag chen rin po che 'gro ba kun la bu gcig pa ltar dgongs pa'i thugs rje can de nyid las gzhan du skyabs gzhan ma mchis so/ /zhes pa'i dad 'dun drag po'i sgo nas smre sngags 'don pa byung zhing / de skabs bdag nyid chen po 'dis re zhig de rnams 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs par gzigs kyang /

dmag mi rnams spro bsring ba'i phyir sngon la mi sna zung sbrel zhig bka' mngags gnang skyes dang bcas rdzong ltar gnang / de bar bla ma dang chos skyong gi drung du bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa'i smon lam rgya chen po mdzad pas nub gcig mtshan lam du/ rje nyid bla brang phun tshogs gling gi tshom chen mo'i shar lho'i mtshams na bzhugs 'dug pa'i sku drung du/ bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs tog la rtag 'grus kyi ngal ba lhur len pa'i mchod dpon smon lam rin chen pa dang / bdag cag la sogs pa'i sku 'khor 'ga' zhig gi khrol ma chen po bzhi 'chi la khad pa shin tu nyams thag pa'i bye'u rad rod mang pos gang ba zhig khyer nas zhabs drung du phul byung ba la rje nyid kyis legs par 'tsho ba'i cho ga mdzad pas de thams cad nyer 'tshe med par gsos nas nam mkha' la 'phur song ba'i tshul shin tu gsal ba zhig byung ste mnal sad pa na/ da lam sems can la phan pa rgya chen po zhig yong ba'i rtags yin pa 'dra snyam pa thugs la 'khrungs shing 'on kyang khrol ma bzhi po 'di gang gi ltas yin nam dgongs pa shar/ sang nyin snga char kyang de lta bu'i bka' lung sku 'khor rnams la dngos su gnang ba byung la/ de nas ston zla 'bring po'i mjug la mgon po drug cu pa'i gter bzlog lo dus kyi zla ba phyi mar gnang srol yod pa de bsu bar mdzad de/ de'i phyi nyin ston zla tha chung dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la dpon slob rags bsdus bcas chibs kyi kha lo legs par bsgyur te/ brag skya chu gshod/ dpal ldan rtse/ gcen lung byams gling / na ring chos rdzong / gam pa lhun grub stag rtse sogs su rim par phebs/ de dag so sos kyang 'bul nod dang bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa sgrub/ de nas rim par brgyud de phag ri bsam 'grub khang du phebs shing gdan chags skabs/ nub cig mnal lam du gur gyi mgon po zhal dkyil 'od dang ldan pa zhig shar phyogs su khyu ru ru bsgyur ba'i spyan 'bur tshugs su gzigs pa dang /

pu tra chen po zhal dkyil zla ba ltar dkar zhing spyan gsum gser mig ltar 'khyil ba zhig gi thugs la bzhed pa'i don rnams 'phral du 'grub pa'i las mdzad pa gzigs snang khyad par can zhig dang / yang lan cig zhing skyong tsa turmu kha bram ze'i gzugs sku mdog sngon po rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa gzi brjid can zhig skyed lhas mgon khang gi nub phyogs kyi logs ngos la bzhugs pa'i sku'i bkod pa gsal bar gzigs pa sogs mnal ltas ya mtshan che ba du ma zhig btud nas byung bas/ de dus chos skyong so so la bstod pa re yang mdzad la/ yang lan cing mnal lam du bya rog chen po gcig gis gcan gzan stag zhig sder mo gnyis kyi bar du khyer nas lcags mchu rnon pos lus la 'debs cing / stag de shi la khad pa'i ngang nas bya rog de gdan sa chen po'i sa dkar logs nas bzhi thog gi bar snang la phar 'phur tshur 'phur dang bcas gshog 'gyur mang po byed bzhin pa'i de ma thag rje nyid kyang skyed lhas mgon khang gi steng na bzhugs yod do dgongs pa la skyed lhas kyi mgon khang rgyab kyi brag logs der stag gi ro de bskyur nas/ sngar gyi bya rog de bya nag chen po gnyis su gyur nas gzi brjid chen po'i gshog 'gyur dang bcas skad snyan po sgrog bzhin pas zhabs drung du thud thud byung ba la bdag nyid chen pos kyang bshos chang mang po gnang ba la sogs pa'i rmi lam shin tu gsal ba zhig byung 'dug pa dang / yang lan gcig gi tshe yab rje chos kyi rgyal po dang bzhi thog tshom dmar du mjal ba na yab rje'i phyag tu sdig pa ra dza zhig bsnams 'dug pa la slar yang sdom kha brgyad sogs srog chags ma rung pa 'ga' zhig sngar gyi sdig pa ra dza dang lhan cig tu me tsha mo zhig la 'debs par mdzad song bas/ rngog dud kyi lung pa khang ba tsam dang / me de tshom bar gyi mgon khang du skyol cig gsung ba snyam byed pa la mnal tshad pa'i snang ba byung gsung ba 'di dag ni/

bdag nyid chen pos sems can rnams bde thabs dge 'brug legs spel gyi chings 'doms gnang ba la/ gegs byed kyi log sgrub kho nar gcig tu phyogs pa'i mi srun pa mtha' dag chos skyong rnams kyis bsgral te/ lho bod kyi chings 'doms thog mar lo lnga'i bar dang de nas gtan chings rim gyis 'byung ba'i rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu gyur te/ rje nyid kyi thugs bzhed bzhin du sgrub pa 'di yang kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar du snang / de ltar phag rir bzhugs pa'i ring la/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi thugs bskyed rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas spyir sems can gyi bde thabs dang / khyad par de skabs kyi 'khrug zing rnams myur du zhi ba zhig byung na ci ma rung dgongs pa'i thugs 'dun drag pos dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la gsol 'debs/ chos skyong rnams la 'phrin bcol dang / khyad par nyin re bzhin thugs dam gsil gtor shin tu smin pa re 'phar du gnang ste/ bka' las kyang da lam gyi gtor ma 'dis gzugs med 'di rnams kyi 'phrin las yang dag byed pa'i rtags yang yang ston pa zhig 'dug gsungs/ gzhan yang zla dus kyi bla ma mchod chog rgyud 'don sogs dang / gsung rtsom yang chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches rgyal bu la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba'i rnal par bshad pa 'phags pa dges pa'i lha'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'di dang / legs par bshad pa rin po che'i rjes su 'jug pa lugs kyi bstan bcos blang dor gsal ba'i me long sogs kyang sngon med gsar du bskrun par mdzad cing / der gnas kyi skye bo mang po la yang thugs rje chen po tshems bu lugs kyi dmar khrid/ grub chen lcags zam pa nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang rgyab chos kyi lung dang bcas pa mang po zhig stsal te/ der 'dus skye bo rnams kyi nang nas ma ṇi dung phyur byed mi dang /

srog gcod kyi dam bca' 'bul mi bgrang ba las 'das pa byung ba sogs mdor na rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po ches 'gro ba'i don la skad cig kyang g.yel ba med pas skal bzang las 'phro can rnams dang ba'i dad pa lhag par 'phel bas sa bon grangs med pa zhig 'debs par mdzad pa yin no/ /de skabs lho bod kyi dmag dpon so sor dge sdig gi spang blang 'di bzhin dgos tshul gyi phebs sgo ci yang zhig stsal kyang / so so nas dang len gdeng khel zhu ba zhig 'phral du ma byung ba nas/ sku'i 'tsho bzhes su re zhig na ring chos rdzogs du phebs/ tshur lam lha lung du skya ser mang po la khrom dbang zhig kyang stsal/ na ring du bzhugs skabs dgon pa ba ri'i bla ma/ der gnas kyi bla ma grwa btsun skal ldan mang po la mgon po trag bshad kyi rjes gnang / rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor/ de nas ser 'phyang zhes pa me mo bya'i lo rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid dgung gi bgrang gzhi drug cu re gcig tu phebs pa na/ na ring nas chibs kyi kha lo slar yang phag rir bsgyur te dmag dpon so sor gnang skyes bka' mngags sogs rmad du byung ba mdzad/ de nas/ chu srin gnas kyi dug can pa/ /dus rnams yol bar 'gyur srid kyi/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /ces pa ltar/ gdul bya rnams 'dul bar bya ba dus la bab pa dgongs nas/ dpon slob rags bsdus zhig spa gro'i mthil rang du phebs/ der phebs tsam nyid na der yod kyi dmag mi rnams blo gcig dang tshig mthun par ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes 'gro ba'i bla ma dam pa khyed 'dir byon pa ni bdag cag rnams kyi rnyed pa legs par rnyed de/ bdag cag ma bsgral ba rnams ni bsgral du gsol/ ma bsgrol ba rnams ni sgrol du gsol lo zhes gsol 'debs shing shin tu dbugs 'byin par gyur to/

/de mtshams rtse gdong nas bdag chen rin po che dpon slob rnams dang / skyi gshod nas zhabs drung dpon g.yog bkris lhun po nas sku tshab sbrel po/ nger e waṃ chos ldan gyi mkhan rin po che nam mkha' rin chen dpon slob sogs kyang rim gyis phebs/ mchod yon rnams bka' bgros thog nas phan tshun legs spel gyi skor 'phen ci yang zhig stsal/ de skabs yul phyogs der spyir yang sa dug kyi nyes dmigs che zhing / khyad par de dus rong tshad che ba rang gi skabs yin pa de lo dgar der dal yam drag po gso dka' ba dag gis khebs pas/ bdo dmag byin dang sna bo gzhan ma tsho thams cad ni sa dug la sogs pa'i bro nad kyi rigs rnams sa mang pos te por rtses te gyag grum shin tu che ba byung yang / bdag nyid chen po'i sku 'khor rnams la snga dro re bzhin ljags chab kyi bsrung ba rgyun ma chad par stsal bas/ de nyid kyi mthus rje nyid dpon slob rnams la de lta bu'i nyes pa ma byung zhing / dmag mi blo ldan grangs dang tshad med pas kyang chu gtsang stobs che ba khyer nas ljags chab zhu bar rgyun ma chad par byung ba de rnams la yang sngar nad kyis thebs pa rnams kyang srog skyon med cing / ma byung ba rnams phyis nas srung thub pa sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan mngon gyur de bzhin byung ba'i tsha/ der gnas kun na re/ 'di lta bu'i rkyen ngan pa ru 'dzings pa'i dkyil du gzhan ma thams cad ni 'di ltar nyams nyes par gyur pa la/ bdag chen rin po che dpon slob rnams la nyes dris gtse ba lta ci/ dmag mi ljags chil gyi bdud rtsi reg tshad bro 'tshal med pa'i bde ba'i dga' ston la sbyor ba mdzad ces smra'o/ /de skabs rtse gdong nas bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dpon slob rnams kyang dam pa 'di'i zhal dkyil mjal ba dang gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol bar bcas nyin re bzhin zhabs drung du phebs/

rje 'dis kyang lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin chen pos sgo nas thugs kyi yol go yang dag pa 'gang bar mdzad/ der bzhugs yul spa gro'i rnal 'byor zer ba de yin pa la/ kong po stong phrag brgal ba dang gzhan dmag mi rnams kyis nyin mtshan rgyun ma chad par bskor ba byas te bzhugs yul gyi mthar bskor lam shin tu byang ba'i shul lam dod pa yang byung / de nas sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos yul 'khor mo 'jig gi drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su lnga sde 'dul ba'i don du gshegs pa na/ de dag ma gus pa'i 'og khrims bcas pa ston pa'i zil gyis rang dbang med par bral ste/ la las bsu/ la las stan 'dings/ la las zhabs bsil ba'i chu bshams te bsnyen zhing bkur ba'i sgo nas thub pa'i gsung mchid thod du blangs pa bzhin du skyob pa mtshungs pa med pa gang gis sku'i nyin byed yul phyogs de'i skye bo rnams kyi mig mkhar shar zhing / gsung zer sgra 'dzin gyi bu gar reg pa tsam gyis 'brug phyogs kyi dpung gi kha lo pa rnams kyang dad pa'i 'dab brgya rang dbang med pa bzhad de 'di skad ces/ spro mo la tshun gyi rong 'di nang gi dmag tshogs ka tsa dang bcas pa thams cad nged rang dbang btsan pa yin na'ang / da lam sa skya zhabs drung sangs rgyas mi'i zol 'dzin sku na smin pa 'di lta bu btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba yin pa la/ sems can rnams thugs blos ma btang ba'i nged kyi rdzong rtsa 'dir dbu gdugs skya ling nge ba dang bcas pa yang yang 'byon pa 'di blos mi bzod pa zhig yong gi 'dug pas bka' gnang dwang len zhu zer ba sogs snyan tshig gi do ker chen po rje nyid kyi zhabs stan du bkrol te/ bdag nyid chen po'i bka' stsal gser gyi cod pan gtsug gi rgyan du shin tu gus par blangs pas dge 'brug gnyis lo lnga yi bar phan tshun gnon pa med pa'i chings 'doms legs par mdzad de/

sems can bgrang ba las 'das pa 'jigs rung gshin rje'i kha sgo mi zad pa drag cing rtsub pa'i duḥkha yun ring por ma nor ba de 'dra ba nas 'byin par mdzad pas/ de thams cad sa thob dga' ba stong la 'gran pa'i bde ba'i yid shin tu myos pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs dang / bzhugs pa'i phyogs su phyag 'tshal ba dang / bskor ba byed pa dang / thal mo sbyor ba la sogs pa dga' mgu'i rnam 'gyur ci yang zhig ston par gyur to/ /de dus chings 'doms kyi bka' mchid grub mtshams/ 'brug pa'i dbu rje so so rdzong dpon/ sa skya pa rang gi dgon pa so so'i bla ma grwa slob sbyin bdag bcas pa dang / rong gi dmag mi phal cher dang bcas pa'i 'khrug rtsod kyis lus sems dub pa'i sdug bsngal las skyabs pa'i dga' spro chen po dang bcas/ lcags ras gser 'bras sogs kyi 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / rje nyid kyis kyang so so'i 'dod dang bstun pa'i slob dpon rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ de'i don bsdus kyi tshigs bcad/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i slob dpon rin po che la gsol 'debs bsam pa myur grub bod khams kun tu bde ba'i dpal ster zhes bya ba ljongs 'di phal cher dang / khyad par yul phyogs der shin tu dar ba 'dug pas bsgom lung zhig dang / thugs rje chen po'i bsgom lung sogs ci la ci 'dod kyi chos kyi char chen po phabs te/ slob dpon pad+ma'i gsol 'debs dang bzang spyod ma ṇi sogs dung phyur mang po'i dam bca' bzhes zhing / so so nas kyang bka' stsal dang du blang ba'i gus spro chen po dang bcas phul/ de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'dis 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad rjes/ hor lugs zla ba drug pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la spa gro nas gdan bteg ste phebs pa'i tshe/ dpung gi kha lo pa rnams kyis dmag mi rnams mjug ma 'gril gyi bar du chings pa rnams bzhugs dgos tshul dang /

khyad par bdag nyid chen po nyid la nges par bzhugs dgos tshul byung ba bzhin rje nyid kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes te phyag bzhes su btab pas bod kyi dmag mi rnams lta ci smos/ rkang bzhi phra mo tshun chad la nyes zho med par phag rir 'byor pas/ dmag mi drag zhan thams cad 'di lta bu bden nam brdzun snyam pa'i slar yang yid dga' bdes khyab par 'gyur/ de nas rim gyis phang thang rdzong dang bshags nang gi bzhugs yul sman ljongs nyams dga' ba der phebs/ bka' las/ da lam sems can la phan pa cung zad byung ba 'di kho bo la de lta bu'i nus pa gtan nas ma mchis kyang / rje btsun gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnam kyi thugs rje dang chos skyong gi mthu rtsal yin par snang / nged phar 'gro ba'i tshe chos skyong srung ma rnams zhal lho rang la gzigs nas 'byon/ tshul log tsa na 'di phyogs la gzigs nas 'byon pa'i rmi lam rgyun chags su yong ba zhig 'dug snga mor lam du byung ba'i khrol ma bzhi po ci yin nam snyam pa de spa gro/ dgon/ gling gzhi/ bum thang bzhi la lta ba 'dug gsung ba sogs dngos su thos la/ de nas phag rir phebs/ sog bod kyi rgyal po gnyis kyi gtsos drung 'khor stobs che ba rnams kyi bka' drin gsob pa'i 'bul ba rgya chen po byung / rgyal rtse nas dbyings sa phyag mdzod chen po'i dkar spro dmar spro 'bul dpang dang bcas/ da lam sa skya zhabs drung nas sku ngal dub la ma ltos par thugs khur che bzhes gnang ba la rten/ chings 'doms don 'khyol byung ba 'di bzhin lho bod gnyis ka la bka' drin che ba byung 'dug pas/ da lam brel ba'i stabs mjal thub pa zhig ma byung na/ slar dbus phyogs su mjal mdun yod pa bzhin de thog zhib rgyas phul chog pa dgos tshul gyi zhu yig gnang / de nas rim gyis chibs kha bsgyur ste gam pa lhun grub stag rtser rdzong dpon rnams kyis zhabs tog phul du phyin pa sgrub shing /

der lho khog gi dmag mi rnams log pa dang dus 'dzoms pas dmag dpon rnams zhabs drung du 'bul ba rgya chen po bcas mjal du byung skabs/ de kha'i dmag dpon zhig na re/ sngon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i rgya'i mi 'gyur chen mo gcod par mdzad pa phul du phyin pa'i rnam thar du snang yang / da lo rje nyid kyi bka' drin las nged lho rong gi dmag mi rnams rang gnas su bde bar log chog pa 'di dus kyi dbang gis sngon gyi de las kyang ngo mtshar zhing bka' drin che ba byung ngo / /zhes legs so'i bstod skur 'bul ba yang thos so/ /de nas na ring dgon pa dang / rin chen gling sogs su phebs lhog pa na ring dang bcas pa'i skye bo rnams kyis zhabs tog phul phyin pa sgrub cing der yod rnams la khrom dbang zhig kyang gnang ste so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyi char chen po 'bebs bzhin par phebs pa'i ngang nas/ zla ba de nyid kyi dmar cha rgyal ba gnyis pa'i nyin dpal sa skya nas thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs 'bring chab 'bangs kyi rta pa'i tshogs dang bcas phebs bsur lha tsho ne khar phebs pas bzhugs gral gyi dga' ston rgya chen po'i ljags bkod kyang mdzad 'dug cing / rje nyid dang mjal ma thag shin tu dges pa'i bka' stsal kyang mang po zhig dang bcas thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur nas gsol rtsis dang gsol ja bzhi tsam gyi bar bzhugs gral kyang de khar gnang / de nas chibs thog khyon nas ha cang mi ring ba zhig na chos skyong 'cham mgon byin rlabs can rnams kyi bsu ba dang / chos sde chen po'i phebs bsu ser 'phreng gzab ma bcas rang gi bsti gnas dam pa bzhi thog bla brang du legs par phebs te lha mi kun dga' bar byed pa'i dga' ston gyi rgyal mtshan spel bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas chos sde lho byang du 'bras 'jam/ mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs phebs ston rgya che bar stsal/

de gong lho rong du bzhugs skabs zhig nyid kyi mtshan lam du lha khang chen mo'i shar lho'i mtshams 'di 'jig la khad pa sogs mtshan ltas cung mi legs pa 'ga' byung nas/ mkhan rin po che nyid rang du sku rim gang dag mdzad dgos lugs sogs bslab ston rgya cher phebs 'dug kyang / dus kyi nyi ma nub rir nye ba'i dbang gi mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid zla ba de'i nyer gsum la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa na bdag nyid chen po 'dis thugs brtse ba chen pos nam yang ma dor ba'i mang ja 'gyed bcas shin tu bzang ba dang / thugs dam skyabs 'jug bsngo ba smon lam sogs bka' drin shin tu che ba gnang / lo de'i ston 'jug la rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs lcam sring gi gtso mdzad/ gdan sa'i bla ma slob dpon/ rgyal rtse zhabs drung rin po che bla ma'i drung khu dbon/ ngam ring mkhan rin po che klu grub dar rgyas/ ngor mkhan rin po che bsod nams rgya mtsho/ yar lung bkra shis rtse nas chos kyi rje bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la sogs pa chos nyan pa brgya phrag tu long pa la/ jo bo a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i tshe sbyin sgrol ma dkar mo'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ de'i zung 'jug gi khrid nyams khrid du stsal te/ lung gi skor la/ sgrol ma'i chos skor bla ma gong ma'i phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam gyi lung sogs dam pa 'di nyid rang gis mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi yig cha mang po'i lung dang bcas pa stsal shing / de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pas bkral ba'i gshed dmar lha lnga'i byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i spros med kyi khrid nyams khrid du shin tu smin par gnang ba'i rgyab chos su/ bir+wa pa'i rgya gzhung yongs rdzogs/ glo lo tsā ba'i spros med stong mthun/ rdo rje 'chang gi spros med mdzes rgyan sogs 'di'i yig cha mang ba/

rje klu grub rgya mtsho'i chos 'byung spros med byin rlabs khrid yig rgyun gyi nyams len sogs yig skor cha tshang ba/ rje mkhyen brtse ba'i khrid yig sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chen po/ rje rang nyid rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs khrid yig bskyed rim rnam bshad sogs 'di skor gyi yig cha bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lung rnams lhug par stsal te/ de dus rje'i gsung las/ gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos tshul spyir dar tshul dang / bye brag bod du dar tshul shin tu rgyas pa zhig gsung byung na'ang 'dir yi ge'i tshegs skyung phyir ma spros shing / rgyas pa ni dam pa 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi chos byung 'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed las rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas jo bo bka' gdams pa nas brgyud pa'i blo sbyong gi skor sogs shin tu rgyas shing mtha' chod pa sku tshe hril po blo sbyong kho na la sbyangs pa lta bu'i legs bshad kyi tshogs ci yang zhig stsol bar mdzad de/ de dus kyi chos nyan pa thams cad dad pa dang nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyi dge blo gong 'phel du gyur te/ bka' gdams chos kyi bang mdzod la dang 'dod kyi dad pa phyogs med du rgyas shing / legs byas kyi 'bras bu bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig bskrun par mdzad pa yin no/ /der rjes sngar gyi chos nyan pa rnams kyi steng du gong gi rnam thar rtsom pa po khro phu nas mkhas pa'i dbang po dus 'khor zhabs gnyis pa dpal rgyas dbang po'i zhabs dang / ras pa zhi ba 'od kyi sprul sku byang chub gling bla ma/ kha ba lhas kyi bla ma gzhan phan 'od zer ba sogs la/ dam pa sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'i zhi byed kyi chos skor cha tshang ba zhig dang / kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs/ zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi rigs mi 'dra ba du ma/

lha mo dud gsol ma'i rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ de'i man ngag be'u bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams dang / rje grol mchog nas brgyud pa'i khrid brgya/ de dang 'brel ba'i yig skor mtha' dag gi lung rnams stsal zhing / khrid brgya gnang dus zhen pa bzhi bral dang sum pa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud/ skyid sdug lam khyer rnams nyams khrid kyi tshul du smin par gnang nas/ der tshogs thams cad zab rgyas kyi chos tshul mtha' dag la blo gros kyi mig bu gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad/ 'gro kun legs byas dge legs 'od stong can/ /las dbang log spyod sgra gcan gyis sgrib pas/ /lus can mun par bzhugs la mi bzod pa'i/ /shugs drag snying rje'i rgya mtsho gyen du 'phyur/ 1 /de tshe snying stobs phrag par 'gro ba yis/ /phan bde'i 'khur chen len bzod khyod thugs mkhar/ /lhag bsam zla ba stong phrag shar ba las/ /mdzad bzang 'od dkar phung pos sa chen bkangs/ 2 /gang gis thugs rje bdud brtsi'i sman sbyor gyis/ /lho bod yid can nyer 'tshe las skyabs pa'i/ /mi phyed dad pa chen po'i gsol 'debs dang / /bsngags brjod lha yis rnga chen srid rtse brgal/ 3 /lha ldan sa la gnas pa'i tshangs pa che/ /dpung tshogs yan lag sna bzhi bsod nams kyis/ /chos srid rnams par 'phel ba'i mchod sprin gyis/ /nam mkha'i khyon yang 'gog pa lta bur byas/ 4 /de ltar 'gro kun bde ba'i sar bkod nas/ /rang gi bsti gnas bho ṭa'i rdo rje gdan/ /gang der 'dus pa'i tshogs la tshe sbyin ma'i/ /zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi ci yang spel/ 5 /gzhan yang dpal ldan gshen rje dmar po yis/ /zab chos snying po spros pa med pa'i khrid/ /byin rlabs dang bcas de dang 'brel ba yis/ /chos tshul rgya mtshos 'gro blo'i bum pa bkang / 6 /byang sems bdag po dpal ldan a ti sha/ /brgyud par bcas las 'ong ba'i bka' gdams gyi/

/chos sgo brgya phrag dus gcig la phye ste/ /kun kyang rgyal sras spyod pa gong 'phel mdzad/ 7 /nag po spyod pa gzugs gzhan bzlog pa'i gar/ /grol mchog zhabs kyis spel ba'i khrid brgya dang / /dud gsol lha mo'i rjes gnang rnam pa gnyis/ /de yi man ngag be'u bum lung dang bcas/ 8 /gzhan yang bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ bka' srung tsa turmu kha'i chos skor 'ga'/ /dam pa sangs rgyas thugs bcud zhi byed kyi/ /chos tshul rgya mtshos don gnyer re ba bkangs/ 9 /ci mdzad bstan dang 'gro ba'i dri ma kun/ /bkru mdzad rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod tshul gang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas blos sa bon mthu rtas pa'i/ /tshad ma legs pas dpyod ldan su mi dad/ 10 /de nas rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi lo rje nyid dgung gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag drug dang nyag ma gnyis su phebs pa na/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba chos sde lho byang 'di nyid mi nyams shing 'phel rgyas la dgongs rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bsod nams bkra shis mkhan po'i 'os 'gabs su shar ste/ g.yag rong rnam gnyis kyi gdan sa mdzad bzhin pa'i ngang nas thub bstan lha chen gyi chos kyi khri ga la ba der 'don pa mdzad de/ dam pa 'di nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa'i shis brjod me tog gi 'phring ba ci yang zhig spel bar mdzad do/ /smras pa/ bsod nams lung rtogs cha shas rdzogs pa'i zla/ /bkra shis 'od dkar bye ba 'dzag pa can/ /gang gis bka' stsal rdo rje shing rta yis/ /thub bstan ku mud dkar po'i tshul du grangs/ /de tshe dam pa'i mgon dang 'dus tshogs kyis/ /shis brjod glu dang me tog gsil ma phab/ /blo gsal pad mtsho 'dus pa'i tshogs nang du/ /nyin byed pho nya dang po shar rir tshes/ /nyin de'i phyi dro'i cha la chos khri chen por phebs te/

gdan sa chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i skya ser bgrang ba las 'das pa la tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i dbang dang / ri khrod ma'i rjes gnang zhig kyang stsal/ de dus dgun grang ba'i skabs yin kyang dbang mo che gnang ba'i nyin nas bzung dpyid gsos ltar sa gzhi ri rlung thams cad drod kyis khyab pa byung ba dang / lhag par de skabs gdan sa 'dir nad rigs phran bu yod pa yang rang zhi la song bas byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan ngo mtshar can bstan te skyed dgu thams cad phan bde'i dpal la spyod par mdzad cing / de mtshams snga sor phag rir dbyings sa phyag mdzod nas dbus su phebs gsol snyan gsan dbab pa ltar/ rtse chen grong stod pa dpon g.yog bcas spyan 'dren gyi mi sna zhabs drung du 'byor te/ lha sar lo gsar gyi thog tu phebs dgos tshul gyi snyan 'bul byung ba bzhin dmar phyogs dga' ba dang po la dpon slob rags bsdus brgya skor zhig chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba mdzad de/ dgon pa rgyas/ dar lung gnyen gyi pho brang sogs brgyud de rkang bzhir phebs pa na/ gzhis kha chen po bsam 'grub rtse nas sa dbang nor bu'i drung gi zhabs tog dang 'bul nod rgya chen po sgrub cing / de dus rje 'dis bka' gnang nas chu mig bla brang 'di sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma du mas bzhugs gnas chos kyang dar sa zhig yin pa la/ da lta phal cher zhig ral du song 'dug pas lha khang 'di rnams la zhig gsos mdzad na sku bsod dang sems can gyi bde skyid la phan nges 'byung bas de bzhin gyi zhal bkod gnang dgos tshul phebs song ba ltar sde pa nas kyang bka' bzhin sgrub ste gnas der lha khang mgon khang sogs nyams gsos zhabs tog phul du phyin pa mdzad nas gzungs bzhugs/ rab gnas sogs la las chen dpon slob 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan rdzong ltar gnang ba bzhin gzungs 'bul phyag nas sogs tshul bzhin mdzad pas 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur pa 'di yin la/

de nas dpon slob rnams kyi dpal rnam klu sding / nor gling / 'breng rtse sogs rim par brgyud de rgyal rtser phebs nye ba na/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i grwa tshang so so'i bla ma slob dpon las tshan tha dad dang bcas pa'i chibs bsu gzab rgyas 'byor/ rtse chen gyi tha mtshams su chos sde nas gzim gur dang bzhugs gdan gyi bkod pa zab gshoms mdzad 'dug pas chibs bshol dben tsam gnang skabs rtse chen gyi grwa tshang so so dang / de phyogs kyi mi sde drag zhan kun gyis zang zing gi 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / dkar spro sogs mchod pa'i bye brag kyang rgya chen por skyil bas bdag nyid chen po'i spyan lam du 'bul ba ma thob dogs pa lta bu'i 'bul thub pa la spro ba dang bcas shin tu rgya che ba byung zhing / de dag so sor yang rang rang gi bsam pa ltar chos kyi 'brel pa dang lugs gnyis kyi bka' mchid gnang skyes bzang po sogs stsal te kun kyang dga' mgu yid rang ba'i rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa bla lhag tu 'phel bar mdzad cing / de nas chibs thog khel ba'i dpal 'khor chos sde nas ser 'phreng gi bkod pa sogs mchod pa'i bye brag kun bzang rnam 'phrul la 'gran pa dang lhan cig gur pa grwa tshang chen mor phebs/ de khar lcags mal zhig gdan chags pa'i ring la/ grwa tshang so so'i bla ma las tshan grwa mang sde dpon mi ser dang bcas pas zang zing gi 'bul nod bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / bsnyen bkur zhabs tog ci yang zhig sgrub cing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang chos sde spyi dang grwa tshang so sor mang ja bsngo rten spyi 'gyed gya noms pa'i gnang skyes dang / so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa yang mtha' yas pa zhig stsal te/ der 'dus thams cad bdag nyid chen po la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyi dad gus gong 'phel du gyur pa yin no/ /der bzhugs thog sna dkar rtse nas mi dbang chen po'i phebs gsol dgos tshul gyi snyan 'bul byung ba bzhin zhal bzhes kyang mdzad/

de nas rim gyis 'om thang du phebs/ de nub kha ba chen po 'bab la nye ba na/ rje nyid kyis gnod sbyin gang ba bzang por gsung gtor rgyas pa zhig gnang zhing bka' bsgo mdzad nas mchod g.yog par steng du song la rkang gling bus shig ces bka' stsal gnang ba bzhin grub mtshams/ de ma khad lha lam gyi rang zhal gsar du tshes pa lta bu byung la/ de nas kha ro la brgyud yar 'brog sna dkar rtser phebs pa'i tshe/ sde bdag chen po nas chibs bsu rgya chen po dang / de skor gyi dgon pa so so'i ser 'phreng dang bcas pho brang gi rtser spyan drangs te gnas der zhag gsum gdan chags pa'i ring la dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag sogs chos kyi char chen po phab ste der gnas thams cad dga' mgu yid rang ba dang bcas sde bdag chen po yang mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste rnyed bkur zhabs tog 'bul nod lha'i dpal 'byor la 'gran nus pa lta bus mchod cing / rgyang ring po'i bar du phebs skyel mdzad pa sogs srid zhu ci yang zhig dang bcas/ slar yang 'di phyogs su phebs dgos pa'i snyan 'bul gsal 'debs zhus shing / de nas dpal sde/ gam pa/ 'jig skyob sogs su phebs rnyed bkur 'bul nod rgya che ba dang / der gnas rnams kyang yid tshim par mdzad/ de'i nang par bar tshigs su chibs bshol gnang skabs/ skyid tshal phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon dgon pa'i grwa rigs yon bdag dang bcas pa thams cad 'dzoms nas rje dpon slob rnams la zhabs tog dang / zang zing gi 'bul ba dpag tu med pa sgrub cing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang grwa tshang spyi dang sger gyi 'dod chos gsol ba btab pa so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa gnang zhing / grwa tshang so sor yang mang ja bsngo rten zang zing gi gnang skyes sogs lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin chen po stsal bas kun kyang gus pa'i sor bcu spyi bor sbyor zhing snyan grags phyogs kun tu grags par gyur to/

/de nub gam pa byang thang du phebs pa'i tshe gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi slob dpon pa rnams dang grwa rigs kyi tshogs du ma dang bcas zhabs drung du 'byor te zhabs tog gya noms pa sgrub cing / yar lam dgon par phebs dgos pa'i gsol btab nan chags su zhus/ bdag nyid chen pos kyang zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas chu shul dang ljangs su phebs pa'i tshe sngar yong ba med pa'i bud med zhig la khog zhugs glo bur du byung ste/ nga bsam yas nas bdag nyid chen po phebs bsu la yong pa yin pas sku drung du smon lam zhig 'debs par thongs zhes gzim chung 'gag tu yus chen po'i tshul gyis sleb byung ba bdag sogs sku 'khor ba rnams kyis ma btang ba'i ngang nas rje nyid du de kha'i gnas tshul phul bas/ ci zer/ bsam yas su nged 'phral du yong rtsis yod pas da lam khams dub pas 'phrad mi thub phebs byung ba bzhin phebs sgo bsgyur bas gnas der rang yal du song / de dgong bka' las kyang da lam gyi khog zhugs de sngon nged dbus la yong skabs chom rkun pa zhig gi dar 'bog kha shas brkus 'dug pa la chos skyong gi 'khor du gtogs pa zhig gis mi de rang la khog zhugs byas nas/ dar 'bog lag tu smin pa zhig byung ba de dus kyi chos skyong gi 'khor de kha da lam kyang yus kyi tshul gyis nged 'phrad du yong ba yin 'dra gsung zhing / thugs dam gtor ma 'phar zhig kyang bka' drin stsal/ snye thang du phebs pa'i tshe yang dgon pa so so'i grwa rigs kyi ser 'phreng dang rnyed bkur zhabs tog shin tu bzang ba sgrub cing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang chos 'brel mang 'gyed sogs so so'i blo kha rdzogs par mdzad/ nang par shun rdzong du phebs pa'i tshe rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa mchod yon nas drung 'khor skya ser rags bsdus kyis chibs bsu gzab ma dang bcas spyan ras te chos 'khor lha sar phebs/ de 'phral zhabs tog rnyed bkur phun sum tshogs pa sgrub par mdzad/
