de nas zhag gnyis song ba'i gza' tshes bzang po'i nyin rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang / dbyings sa chen po bcas par mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i phan tshun thugs snang dag pa'i gsung gleng gi rim pa rgyun ring po'i bar du mdzad cing / dkar spro sogs bzhugs gral gyi dga' ston kyang gzab gshom du mdzad/ de rjes zhag 'ga' nas sog po'i rgyal po rnams kyang 'bul snod rgya che ba dang bcas dam pa 'di nyid dang mjal te zhabs tog dang rnyed bkur ci yang zhig byung zhing / de nas jo bo rin po che/ rang byon lnga ldan bcu gcig zhal sogs lha sa mthil gyi gtsug lag khang rnams kyi rten so so la zhal gser 'bul ba dang bcas snyan dar dkar me zhal zas sogs mchod pa'i bye brag kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu gshoms par mdzad de mjal bar phebs/ rten so so'i drung du yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phyag dang mchod pa smon lam rgya chen po 'debs par mdzad cing / bka' las kyang da lam jo bo rin po che mjal skabs yid snang shin tu bde ba zhig byung bas rang re dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don rnams gegs med du 'grub pa zhig yong ba 'dug gsungs/ de nas zhag 'ga' song ba na/ po ta la'i gtsug lag khang gi rten rnams dang / khyad par skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti/ jo bo lo ke shwa ra sogs la smon lam gang btab 'grub nges pa ngo mtshar ba'i rten de dag gi drung du yang zhal gser dang mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa dang bcas yan lag bdun pa phyag mchod sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas thugs bskyed smon lam rgya chen po mdzad cing / dam pa 'di nyid thugs bskyed rmad du byung bas sems can gyi bde skyid bstan pa spyi bye brag gi 'phel rgyas la dgongs pa'i bsngo smon gyi tshigs bcad bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba bka' rtsom gnang ste/ lha sa'i jo shāka drung dang po ta la'i rten rnams kyi drung bcas par dam pa rang nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa'i tshogs kyis smon lam 'bum ther zhig dang /

gzhan la yon gnang nas smon lam gyi rgyun 'dzugs par mdzad de 'bum ther lnga tsam sgrub par mdzad/ de mtshams nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang / 'dren pa dam pa 'di nyid bzhag bdun gyi bar la nyin re bzhin mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i bka' gnas mtha' dag la dri ba dris lan gyi tshul gyis so so nas legs bshad kyi rim pa rgyun ma chad pa 'bel gtam du mdzad pas sngon dus kyi mkhan slob zung ltar/ sa gsum gyi 'dren pa mchog gnyis ka'ang so so nas dang 'dod kyi thugs dad lhag par 'phel te phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bur gyur pa yin la/ de ltar lha sar zhag bco lnga tsam zhugs pa'i ring la/ rtse gdong nas bdag chen rin po che 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub pa/ dwags la sgom po'i sprul sku rin po che/ yongs 'dzin rin po che sprul pa'i sku/ rdo rje brag nas sprul sku rin po che sogs 'brug phyogs dang rnying ma'i sprul sku du ma dang / nā lan+d+re nas bco brgyad dbon po/ grwa thang mkhan po/ rnam rgyal ser khang dpon slob skyed tshal bla ma/ sa skya rab 'byams pa sogs chos sde du ma'i bla ma slob dpon du ma dang / sna dkar rtse nas sde bdag sku gzhon pa sku mched sogs skya ser mang po zhal mjal ba dang gsung gi bdud rtsi gsol bar zhabs drung du phebs/ rje nyid kyis kyang so so'i thugs dang bstun pa'i dbang lung man ngag rjes gnang sogs gang la gang dgos thogs med du stsal bas so so nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob te 'bul nod kyang blos mi 'khyud pa phul/ de skabs lha sa smon lam chen mo dang stabs 'grig pa nas tshogs chen mor mang ja 'gyed bcas rnam gzhag che chung sogs shin tu bzang ba dang / gzhan yang dbus phyogs kyi dgon che phra yod do cog la mang ja 'gyed bcas rgya dpangs che ba so sor stsal/ de nas nā len+d+ra'i bla ma grwa rigs sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i spyan 'dren gyi pho nya yang yang byung ba dang /

bdag nyid chen po yang rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa de bstan pa spyi sger la bka' drin che ba nas sku gdung mjal ba dang / smon lam legs par phebs bzhed kyi thugs mdun rgyun chags su yod par brten/ de phyogs su phebs pa'i zhal len tsam gnang kyang / dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang nas chos skyong chen pos da lam phan yul phyogs la phebs par sku dog 'phran bu yod pas/ 'di phyogs su 'phral du phebs dgos tshul gyi snyan 'bul byung bar brten/ mchod yon du yang de bzhin gyi bka' stsal gnang ba'i de'i nang par rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa/ phyag mdzod dang bcas pas zang zing gi 'bul nod rnam thos bu'i 'byor pa la 'gran pa lta bu'i mchod sprin dang / phebs lam sogs su rdzong mgo so so nas mkho dgu'i yo byad gya noms pa dang / slar chos gzhis 'bur dod zhig kyang 'bul ba'i bka' bzhes dang bcas 'bul ba rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas bsam yas su chibs kyi kha lo phyogs te mchod yon nas drung 'khor rags dus skya ser gyi gru kha bar phebs skyel zhus/ der gnang skyes rgya chen po dang lugs gnyis kyi bka' mchid 'phral dang yun du phan pa stsal bas khong rnams gus spros myos te rje nyid kyi zhal dkyil las gzhan du lta bar ma mchis so/ /don de dag la 'di skad/ zur phud lnga pa'i ma dros chu gter las/ /nye bar 'ong ba'i 'khon rigs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /byang phyogs gangs ri'i mgon po sa skya pa/ /'jig rten mig gcig rigs brgya'i cod pan mchog 1 /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba mi yis lha/ /bsod nams mtshan can sa yi tshangs pa ches/ /gsung 'phrin gser gyi rnga sgras bskul ba las/ /dbus 'gyur skye dgu'i bsod nams mgron du chas/ 2 /de tshe ljongs der gnas pa'i lha mi kun/ /rang cag dkar pa'i legs lam mthu che zhing / /ring nas smin pa'i dus las ma yol bar/ /rang rang re ba skad gcig la rdzogs pas/

3 /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po thob bo zhes/ /mgrin pa gcig pas ngag gis shis brjod cing / /mchod sprin rgya mtshor 'khyil dang lhan cig par/ /'bum phrag rta pa'i dpung gis ring nas bsus/ 4 /de dang lhan cig rgyal dbang sras bcas kyis/ /nor bu'i bang mdzod 'bum gyi sgo phye nas/ /nyi zer rdul dang mnyam pa'i mchod sprin dang / /mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang po'i shis brjod phul/ 5 /srid pa gsum na 'dren par rloms kun gyis/ /do zla med pa'i 'byung gnas su gzigs nas/ /rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen pos mngon mchod pa/ /legs par sred med kyis kyang cis mi rtogs/ 6 /sprul pa'i lha mis bzhengs pa'i jo bo gnyis/ /rang byung lnga ldan bcu gcig zhal sogs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa zhabs skor gsal sbyangs kyis/ /snod bcud kun la phan bde'i cho ga brtsams/ 7 /gang khyod rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa yis/ /'gro mang skyabs kyi mchog tu gyur cig pa'i/ /'khor ba dong nas dkrug pa'i thabs mkhas kyi/ /smon lam mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du btab/ 8 /mthon po'i rigs las byung ba'i sprul pa'i sku/ /sgrub rgyun bstan pa'i zhal 'dzin mngon mtho ba/ /sgam po pa sogs sna chen 'dzin pas kyang / /dbang lung man ngag mang po'i bka' drin zhus/ 9 /de tshe bdud rtsi'i 'od can dang / /khyod kyi grags pa mnyam du dkar/ /rgyal bstan 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal dang / /bde skyed kun+da lhan cig dar/ 10 /kha ba'i ljongs kyi mkhas btsun bzang kun gyis/ /khyod zhabs spyi bor mchod la ngo mtshar ci/ /zhabs sen nyin byed 'bar bas ma 'tshig pa'i/ /che dgu'i gtsug gi ral pa de ya mtshan/ 11 /de nub gung thang du phebs pa'i tshe de phyogs kyi dgon pa'i grwa rigs mi ser dang bcas pa'i zhabs tog 'bul nod kyang rgyas pa zhus shing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa du ma stsal te so sor yid tshim par mdzad/

de nas gzhis kha bde chen gyi klu sding du skyid gshod zhabs drung gi gdan drangs te gzhis len rgyas pa'i rnyed bkur dang zang zing gi 'bul ba dpag med phul/ de nub pho rog thang du bzhugs pa'i nang par gser la brgyud de zur mkhar du phebs pa'i tshe/ bsam yas nas mkhan tshangs rab 'byams pa thar pa rgyal mtshan sogs lcog pa dpon g.yog rnams dang chos skyong chen po'i sku rten pa bcas phebs bsur 'byor zhing / de'i nang par bsam yas su phebs pa'i bar lam du rab byung grwa tshang gi mkhan po ngag dbang lhun grub pa las tshan so so bcas pa dang / skyid gshod zhabs drung nas phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas spyan drangs/ de dus chos skyong chen po bdag nyid chen po'i zhal dkyil mjal bar thugs ring pas 'phral du phebs pa zhig yong nges zhes kun gleng yang / rje nyid kyi gsung las/ nged na so mtho ba dang lus gshed chung bas bsam yas su slebs pa'i nyin chos skyong phebs na lcog sogs su 'gro dgos pa'i lus sems dub pa zhig yong 'dug pa nas/ de nyin ma 'byon cig snyam pa byas pas sku phebs mi yong thag chod gsung ba ltar/ dpon slob chibs rags rnams rdo mchod thang ka'i thad du phebs pa na sku rten par rta thog tu chos skyong phebs la khad pa zhig la yal song bas/ rje nyid kyi bka' las/ chos skyong chen pos cung zad kyang mi 'da' bar der yod kun yid ches te spro ba lhag par 'phel bar 'gyur cing / de nas rab byung ba rnams kyi ser 'phreng dang / rnga bo che dang / 'cham mgon rnams kyi bsu ba dang / chos skyong chen po'i ljags bkod gnang ba'i 'bag dang chas gos mi 'dra ba du ma gyon pa'i gzigs mo chod pa'i bye brag mang po dang / bsam yas sde shar nub kyi mi rnams kyi dbu rgyan dang rus rgyan sogs dpa' bo'i chas sprad pa dang / 'bag gyon shing rol stabs dang bcas 'chams pa'i bkod pa sogs bsu ba'i bye brag mi 'dra ba dpag tu med pa zhig gis rje dpon slob rnams pho brang gong du spyan drangs/

bdag nyid chen pos kyang lha sde mi sde bcas su zang zing gi gnang skyes gya noms pa stsal/ nangs par chos skyong chen po'i bzhugs gnas sde brgyad rba klong 'khrug pa'i gnas dpe har lha'i pho brang gi yang rtser rje dpon slob rnams kyis bsang mchod rgyas par mdzad de lha mi mjal phrad mdzad par nye ba na/ smod nas sogs la ma ltos par chos skyong rang babs su byon nas/ re shig bdag nyid chen po dpon slob rnams lcog gi phyir phebs te/ chos skyong gis gsol go mchod grub bstun rten 'brel legs cha dang bcas mkhan tshangs rab 'byams pa rje nyid spyan 'dren du byung bas/ dpon slob rnams lcog gi 'khyams rwa 'og ma'i sgo nang du phebs mtshams/ de gong nas sa skya pa'i zhal ngo bgres gzhon sogs yul gnyan su phebs kyang chos skyong chen po rdo skas kyi mgo las phyir mi 'byon pa zhig yin 'dug na'ang / de skabs sen rnams la mchong zhing lding ba'i rgyug sral dang bcas 'khyams rwa 'og ma'i phyi sgo la nye ba'i bar du phebs bsu mdzad de/ lha mi mjal 'phral chos skyong chen pos dbu rmog phud de gus pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang dang bcas spyan drangs te rje dpon slob rnams rdo skas kyi rtser phebs pa dang chos skyong chen pos sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bstan pa dar ba'i phyir du lha rgyal thang gsum bod zhes gsungs pa ltar/ der tshogs kyi khrom dmar smug tu 'khyil ba rnams kyis 'brug stong dus gcig la ldir ba lta bu'i lha rgyal thang gsum bos mtshams/ rje nyid dang chos skyong gnyis khri'u chung so sor bzhugs shing / sku 'khor gyi tshogs rnams zhabs 'bring du 'khod 'phral de ka la/ 'phrin las kyi mgon po dmar po nyid shin tu dges pa'i mdangs dang ldan zhing sku 'khri li li 'dar ba'i sgo nas gus 'dud kyi nyams 'gyur du ma dang bcas/ lha mi gnyis dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du gsungs gleng mang du mdzad/

de dus chos skyong ba'i gsungs las/ dge bshes sngon slob dpon pad+ma'i phyag nas phog pa'i gdug 'dre'i sdig khrab sha gos dang bcas pa 'di la/ khyed sa skya dge bshes rnams kyis zhig gsos mdzad pa las gzhan sus kyang byar mi rung bas/ sngon sngags 'chang chen po yab sras rnams kyis nyams gso mdzad pa ltar/ da lam kyang dge bshes kyis phyag len la thebs pa mdzad dgos shing / bzo bo sogs dge bshes rang gi blos bcad pa byas pas chog de nam grub bar dge bshes rang yang bzo bo rnams dang lhan cig 'bral med du phebs dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar zhal gyis bzhes te de'i nangs par rang nas phyag bzhes su mdzad pa'i bdag nyid chen pos gsung brtag mdzad pa'i 'os babs kyi bzo bo rnams dang bcas gsol khrab/ khrab gdan/ dbu rmog dang bcas pa'i nyams gso la stsal thon mdzad pas phal cher grub kyang / tshes gsum sku phebs dang thug ches pas ma tshar dogs sku brten pa dang / rgyun par gsol khrab 'bul ba'i lcog gi grwa pa de gnyis kyis rje nyid kyi bka' ma byung yang bzo bo rnams kyi las grogs byas pa la chos skyong gi khu ldog gi rnam pas/ khong gnyis la de ma thag lus la shu 'bur mi zad pa du mas btab ste so so nas 'jigs shing ha las par gyur nas/ bdag nyid chen por ljags sngags zhus te byugs pas gzhi med du dengs pa'i byin rlabs mngon gyur can byung zhing / de dus chos skyong chen po'i gsung gi gdug 'dre'i dpe dkar gyi dngos spyad rnams la gzhan gyis 'jug cha med pas dge bshes kyi deb tu khyon pa'i phyag dam 'byar ba zhig mdzad dgos pa'i zhu gsol phul/ rje btsun dam pa'i bka' bzhin nyid kyi 'phrin las pa chen po phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan pas zhal bkod kyi rgyas btab cing / lugs gnyis la spyan yang ba mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rjes phyag bris 'khur bzhes nas zhag gnyis kyi khong du deb bris su btab ste bdag nyid chen po'i phyag dam 'byar ba mkhan tshang rab 'byams pa'i lag tu 'jog pa mdzad cing /

de nas tshes gsum gi nyin sku phebs gzab ma dang bcas gsol khrab/ khrab gdan/ dbu rmog dang bcas pa nyams gso mdzad pa de thog mar bzhes pa dang bstun/ bdag nyid chen pos 'phrin las kyi mgon po dmar po de nyid la/ bkrags kho na la grub pa'i khyad gos kyi khrab gdan de kha'i thog drangs/ khrab rmog gri gsum/ ja gos dar/ stag lpags gra sder ma nyams pa lha rta bzang ba sogs spyan gzigs 'bul nod rgya dpangs chen po stsal zhing / chos skyong chen po'i dgongs bzhed ltar du 'grub pas shin tu dgyes te khrom chen por ngom pa ltar mdzad de/ de nas lcog gi sbug tu lha mi gnyis bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas srung zhing spel ba'i bka' bgros kyang yun ring du mdzad la/ de dus chos skyong rang gi dgongs pa la rje nyid bsam yas su bzhugs ring la yang yang du lha mi mjal ba zhig dgongs par 'dug kyang / rje nyid sku khams ngan pas skabs skabs su mjal mchog pa'i bsed bkrol gnang bas chos skyong gis kyang zhal gyis bzhes shing / de dus stag rtse nas skyid gshod zhabs drung bsam yas su phebs pa rje nyid dang mjal ba'i tshe zhal dkyil gzigs ma thag dad pa lhag par g.yos te/ slar sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad 'phrin gzigs pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes nas bka' chos kyi rim pa yang mang du zhus shing / rnyed bkur gyi zhabs tog kyang rgya dpangs chen po rgyun du sgrub pa dang / lhag par bdag nyid chen po sa skyar bzhugs dus gshin 'dre gdug pa can 'ga' zhig la lam ston bskyar nas mdzad pas/ gnas ngan nas 'phos pa'i rtags mtshan gsal por byung ba'i snyan grags la brten/ bdag nyid chen por nang sbyar gyi bslab ston zhus te/ zho kha bla ma'i thog drangs de dus bsams yas na gshin 'dre gdug pa can sum cu rtsa grangs zhig yod pa thams cad dus gcig la lam ston mdzad dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pa la rje nyid kyi chos skyong sku phebs byung ba zhig la de bzhin gyi grogs ldan mdzad dgos pa'i bka' stsal gnang ba na/

gdong 'dre la yang las 'chol ba la kho mo yod kyang da lam dge bshes kyi ngo la btang bas chog gsungs pa bzhin/ nangs par lam ston gnang rgyu'i do nub 'byung po de zhabs drung du thal gyi byung nas gus 'dud kyi rnam 'gyur ci yang zhig byas 'dug pa de'i tshul nangs par bka' las dngos su thos la/ de nas bdag nyid chen po dpon slob mang ba zhig gis kun rig gi cho ga rgyas pa mdzad nas/ lam ston gnang ba'i gshin 'dre rnams kyi ming byang sreg chog mdzad pa na/ shog bu bsregs pa'i dri med par sha chen gyi dri 'dra ba zhig thul thul byung ba bsam yas gnyer pa gnyis dang sku rten pa bcas zhabs drung na yod pa rnams kyis dngos su tshor bas khong rnams ha las par gyur to/ /de tshun chad gshin 'dre de rnams kyi gnod pa byung ba'i gtam gzhi med du gyur pa 'di ni rje nyid kyi mthu stobs dang nus mthu'i byin rlabs la rten gshin po de rnams dang mi phyugs bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gi srog skyabs pas mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa bla na med pa stsal ba 'di yang gzhan las phul du byung ba'i rnam thar du snang zhing / der zla skor tsam zhig bzhugs pa'i ring de dag gi bar la rab byung chos sde grwa pa rnams dang / phyogs nas byon pa'i dgon pa so so'i bla ma grwa rigs du ma 'dus pa la/ kyai rdo rje'i lam dbang / rgyu dbang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / tshe dpag med lha dgu/ grub rgyal ma/ lcags gdong ma/ grub chen nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra ming sring / dkar bdud lcam dral/ bran bdud/ rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ seng ge sgra/ sman bla/ bka' gdams nas brgyud pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig khyung nag khyung khra/ 'byung 'dul rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / sman bla'i mdo brgyad brgya pa mdo chog dang bcas pa/

bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i bsam yas kyi gnas bshad chen mo/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i chab gtor gyi yi ge dang / gtor ma brgya rtsa/ 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ sa paṇa dang 'jam dbyangs sbags sgrub kyi chos rgyal ma'i 'don thabs/ slob dpon pad+ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ thugs rje chen po'i bsgom lung sogs/ de ltar dbang rjes gnang lung byin rlabs bsgom lung sogs chos kyi 'khor lo nyin mtshan med pa bskor ba mdzad de/ der 'dus thams cad 'dod chos kyi re ba yongs su rdzogs nas thams cad mgrin gcig par/ da lo gser gyi pha bong sgor 'gril gyi ngo mtshar dang bsod nams che ba 'di lta bu 'byung ba zhes thams cad gus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas snyan grags phyogs kun tu sgrog par byed cing / de skabs nyin gcig dkar zhal mthil gyi mkhan po bo dhi sa twa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas bsam yas kyi skya ser dang / phyogs nas 'dus pa'i skye bo khri phrag tu long pa la/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma'i dbang mo che rgyas par stsal te so so nas 'bul nod kyang rgya chen po grub pa yin la/ de nas gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse rigs gsum gling bzhi gling phran brgyad dang bcas pa'i lha khang rnams la mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas dpon slob rnams kyis rim pas mjal bar phebs te phyag dang yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas thugs bskyed bzang po dang bcas smon lam rgya chen po 'debs par mdzad cing / yang nyin gcig chos rgyal chen po dang / chos skyong chen po gnyis sku phebs thog bdag nyid chen po spyan drangs te lcog tu phebs pa'i tshe/ chos skyong chen pos bkas bskul nas/ dbu rtse chen mo'i dbang phyug chen po'i drung du phebs te/ chos skyong gnyis skyid gshod zhabs drung rnams kyis thogs drangs der 'dus kyi skya ser mang du tshogs pa rnams la bdag nyid chen pos slob dpon rin po che bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i slob dpon rin po che gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub ma'i ljags lung stsal te/

de nang gi bzhed don rnams tshul bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad dgos pa chos skyong gnyis ka la bka' bstsal bas/ dam ldan gnyis kyis kyang de bzhin du sgrub pa zhal bzhes phul/ der skabs chos skyong chen pos skyid gshod zhabs drung la dpal bsam yas res su bor ba byas mi chog pa'i bka' nan che ba tsam stsal ba la bdag nyid chen pos khong sku mched 'di pa tshos bsam yas kyi lha khang sogs la zhig gsos yang dag mdzad 'dug pas chos skyong rnam gnyis kyis kyang skyid gshod zhabs drung 'di pa la sku tshe la bar chad med cing thugs bsam bzhin 'grub pa mdzad dgos/ lhag par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / 'gro ba sems can rnams la bde skyid 'byung ba'i byed por slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bka' bsgos pa bzhin/ da lta sngags 'chang bdag gis dran gsos btab pa ltar las mi g.yel ba'i bka' bsgo shin tu rgyas pa zhig stsal bas der 'dus kyi skya ser mang pos kyang thos shing sems thog tu smin pas bdag nyid chen po la mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes/ skabs der chos skyong chen po sde bdag skyid gshod pa bcas pas gsol btab zhus pa bzhin bdag nyid chen po dpon slob mang ba zhig gis dbu rtse chen mor dpal kyai rdo rje la brten pa'i rab gnas nyin gang ma rgyas pa zhig mdzad de phyi dro'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ chos skyong chen po lha mi zhabs 'bring pa'i tshogs dang bcas rje nyid kyi phyag phyir phebs te gtsug lag khang sde dang bcas pa la zhabs skor phyag nas rgyas pa zhig kyang mdzad/ de'i nangs par nas bzung ste gling bzhi gling phran sogs lha khang zhig gsos grub pa rnams la dpon slob rags bsdus zhig gis phebs te rim pa bzhin phyag nas smin rgyas su gnang ba'i sgo nas/ der yod kyi lha mi kun gyi re ba yongs su gang bar mdzad pa yin la/

de dag ni thun mong ba tsam yi ger bkod pa yin gyi thun mong ma yin pa dam pa gang gi bka' las chos skyong chen pos nam yang 'dor ba med pa'i 'phrin las rgya chen po sgrub pa la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod na'ang chos skyong bka' gnyan pas 'dir dri ba ma spobs so/ /de nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar nye ba na skyid gshod zhabs drung nas rnyed bkur 'bul dpangs che ba sgrub cing / slar yang bsam yas su lan cig phebs thub pa cis kyang gnang dgos zhing zhabs pad kyang bstan 'gro'i gtsug rgyan du yun ring brtan pa'i thugs 'dun sogs mdzad dgos pa'i snyan 'bul yang thugs bsam rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas phul/ rje nyid kyis kyang gang ci'i bslab ston lhug stsol gnang ste thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa byung ba yin la/ rje dpon slob rnams gnas mchog der bzhugs ring la rab byung chos sder mang ja 'gyed bcas lan grags mang ba dang / bzang ja sbyor sbrel thog sa le sbram gyi 'gyed dang / tshogs khro chen po zhig kyang sbyor 'jags mdzad de lha mi kun gus zhen che ba'i thog dad pa'i rgya mtsho ches cher 'phel bar gyur to/ /de ltar bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po sgrub par mdzad nas/ zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer dgu'i snga char chibs kha bsgyur ba mdzad de/ de nub mon mkhar rnam sras gling du phebs/ sde pa yum sras bcas pa dang / de'i phu na rnying dgon zhig gi bla ma grwa rigs bcas par dam pa 'di nyid kyi dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag sogs so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa stsal zhing / sde pa nas kyang 'bul nod shin tu rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba mdzad/ de nas bye rdzing tshogs pa'i spyan 'dren dang bcas chibs thog khyon pas dpon slob rnams lam bzhugs mdzad pa na/ de dang dus mnyam mchim phu'i sgrub gnas gur dkar phug gi thad nas 'ja' dkar po yid du 'ong ba gcig shing sdong gi rtsa ba'i tshul gyi rgyang gis thon nas/

de las yal ga dang lo 'dab kyi tshul gyi 'ja' ri mo ngo mtshar can phyogs mtshams thams cad du gyes te/ rje dpon slob rnams kyi dbu steng du thur ma brgya pa phub pa ltar du gyur pa'i ya mtshan can gyi ltas ngo mtshar ba dang bcas rim gyis bye rdzing du phebs par nye ba na khong rnams kyis chibs bsu rgyas pa ser phreng gzab ma dang bcas spyan drangs te bla brang der zhag gnyis gdan chags pa'i bar la tshogs pa rnams la 'du khang chen mor rjes gnang / rigs gtad sgom lung gi rigs mang po dang bcas chos kyi char chen po phabs shing / kha che paṇa chen gyi rdza sku phyag nas ma mjal ste smon lam thugs tshim pa mdzad/ de dus grwa phyi chos skyong babs nas bdag nyid chen po'i drung du byon pa la/ gsung chos kyi 'brel pa zhig gnang / de dus rje gsung sprul gyi dbon po 'dod chos 'dra zhu bar byung ba la khong rang gi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos rnams rdzogs par gnang nas/ gsung sprul sku cung zad bsnyung ba la snyan tshig tshigs bcad zhig dang gnang skyes rgya dpangs che ba stsal zhing / khong jo gdan tshogs pa spyi sger so so nas kyang zhabs tog rnyed bkur 'bul nod sogs rgya chen po bsgrubs/ de phyogs kyi skya ser khri phrag du long ba la ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas rgyud pa'i tshe dbang zab mo khrom chos su stsal te kun kyang yid tshim par mdzad cing / tshogs par mang ja bsngo rten lo grangs mang po zhig 'tsho ba'i 'gyed bzang po'i bsnyen bkur mdzad de/ der yod thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob te dga' mgu yid rang bar mdzad pa yin la/ de nas dpon slob rnams grwa thang phyogs su phebs te der yod kyi mkhan po las tshan grwa tshang sbyin bdag dang bcas pa rnams kyis chibs bsu rgyas pa dang / 'dus tshogs byin gyis kyang ser 'phreng rgyas pa dang bcas pas spyan drangs nas sa phyogs der zhag lnga tsam gdan chags pa'i ring la/

grwa thang gi mkhan po las tshan drag bsdus don gnyer mtha' dag tshogs pa byin bcas pa la bdag nyid chen pos zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul/ gur zhal pu tra/ dur khrod bdag po sogs chos skyong mang po'i rjes gnang / sa paṇa 'jam dbyangs sbags sgrub/ dbyug gu ma'i chos skor/ khyung khra/ khyung nag gi rjes gnang / 'byung 'dul ri khrod ma/ dmar po skor gsum la sogs pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa mang po nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu stsal zhing / der yod rnams dang phyogs nas 'dus pa'i skye bo khri phrag tu longs pa la dbang mo che dang thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung gi bka' drin kyang stsal zhing / grwa tshang pa dpon slob rnams kyis kyang gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi phyag len dang mthun pa'i las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i gar 'cham dang / zhang blon gnas pa'i g.yag sang gi cho 'phrul ngo mtshar can gyi gzigs 'bul rnams rim par phul zhing / der yod skya ser drag zhan kun gyis rnyed bkur zhabs tog dang 'bul ba'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pa bsgrubs/ de de'i skabs nas rje dpon slob rnams nyin gcig byams pa gling gi gnas gzigs la phebs pa'i tshe/ der bzhugs kyi bla ma las tshan grwa rigs dang bcas pas ser phreng gzab mas spyan drangs te rnyed bkur zhabs tog 'bul ba'i rnam grangs rgya chen po bsgrubs shing / rje dpon slob rnams kyis kyang paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i sku gdung hril po bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang / sku 'bum chen mo'i steng 'og gi lha khang thams cad zhib par mjal bar mdzad cing / der yod kyi sgrub sde nam mkha' mdzod pa rnams kyis kyang 'bul nod dang zhabs tog rgyas par phul/ grwa pa 'das grong mang po byung ba la rten/ de la phan pa'i spyan dmigs gnang dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin rje nyid kyis smin rgyas gnang / khong rnams kyis gsol ba btab ngor dbang zhig stsal/ de nub slar yang grwa thang du phebs/

de'i nang par rgya gling tshogs pa rnams kyis spyan drangs nas khong rnams kyi chibs bsu ser 'phreng sogs rgyas pas gdan drangs te bla brang du phebs/ rnyed bkur zhabs tog phul phyin bsgrubs shing rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i gsung chos kyi rigs du ma zhig stsal bas kun kyang yid tshim par gyur/ de nas 'du khang du phebs te sangs rgyas kyi tshem la sogs pa nang mjal byin rlabs can ngo mtshar ba mang du 'dug pa rnams mjal bar mdzad de/ rje 'di nyid kyis kyang grwa thang / byams pa gling / nam mkha' mdzod/ rgya gling tshogs pa sogs dgon rigs la rgya ja'i rnyed bkur lan grangs mang ba dang / bsngo rten 'gyed sogs dngos gtsang kho nas gnang skyes stsal bas kun kyang lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin la spro ba mchog tu gyur to/ /de'i sang nyin dol gyi chos 'khor gnas su phyag phebs pa'i tshe/ der gnas kyi bla ma/ grwa pa rags bsdus kyis chibs bsu dang / dge 'dun byings kyis ser 'phreng dang bcas bla brang du spyan drangs nas dad ldan so so'i re ba bskong bar mdzad/ de'i sang nyin 'du khang du rje nyid phebs te gsol btab bzhin gyi 'dod chos 'ga' zhig stsal/ phyi dro'i dus la babs pa na skya ser stong phrag du ma 'dus pa la dbang mo che zhig kyang gnang ste/ thams cad chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad cing / 'dus tshogs la yang mang ja bsngo rten spyi 'gyed sogs chos rgyags gnyis ka'i bka' drin stsal/ de'i phyi nyin skyid gshong / rwa ba smad kyi chos sde chen por mkhan po grwa pa rags bsdus kyis chibs bsu/ dge 'dun dmangs kyis ser 'phreng dang bcas bla brang du spyan drangs te/ zhag gnyis bzhugs pa'i phyi ma la/ skya ser khri grangs su long pa tsam la dbang mo che stsal zhing / chos sde'i 'du khang du mkhan slob 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa la rong ston gyi chos tshan brgya rtsa'i lung gis gtsos pa'i kho rang tsho'i 'dod chos du ma zhig nyin gcig la grub pa stsal/

chos bdag rgyal po bse khrab can la yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i bskang gso tshigs bcad ma sogs mkhan po'i 'dod zhus ltar gsung rtsom yang mang po gnang shing / de phyogs kyi chos sde rnams su mang ja lan grangs mang ba'i thog bsngo rten spyi 'gyed rgya dpangs shin tu che ba bstsal te/ der bzhugs kun kyang lugs zung gi bka' drin la yid rang zhing dad pa 'phel bar gyur/ de'i nangs par rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen por phebs pa'i bar lam du/ dwags po grwa tshang gi mkhan slob dge 'dun bcas pa byon nas zhabs tog bsnyen bkur 'bul ba rgya cher bsgrubs te/ khong tsho'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa kha yar zhig stsal te/ de nas dpon slob rnams chibs thog khel ba'i chos sde chen po dang thag nye bar phebs pa na/ rgya nag ha shang dang lha'i bu/ chos skyong gi rnam 'phrul las mkhan gyi bsu mar mtshon pa'i 'bag dang chas gos mi 'dra ba ya mtshan can mang po gyon pa'i phebs bsu du ma yang zhabs drung du 'byor te/ de nas rim par chos sde chen po'i mdun du phebs pa na der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun byings kyis ser 'phreng gzab ma/ mdzes shing brjid chags pa mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa'i mdun nas bsus te bla brang chen mo'i rdo rje gdan pa'i gzim chung du spyan drangs/ de nub nas bzung zhag bcu gsum gyi bar der gdan chags te/ yar lung bkris rtse nas chos rje bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i gtso mdzad/ chos sde chen po'i slob dpon rnam gsum dang chos 'chad kyi bla ma sogs dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ kyai rdo rje'i lam dbang / rgyu dbang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra ming sring / dkar bdud lcam dral/ bran bdud sogs kyi rjes gnang / 'du khang chen mor sngar gyi chos nyan pa'i khar phyogs nas byon pa'i bla ma grwa rigs yon bdag dpon rigs sogs skya ser bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig la/

'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ 'jam dbyangs nag po/ u tsa me dbang ma/ 'byung 'dul me dbang ma/ khyung khra/ khyug nag mi g.yo ba dkar po/ mi g.yo ba sngon po chu srung bcas pa/ seng gdong ma sngo dmar/ gung chen nas brgyud pa'i gtor dbang / bka' gdams nas brgyud pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig grub thob brgyad cu'i byin rlabs sogs rjes gnang zur ka dang byin rlabs mang ba/ lhag par sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang yongs rdzogs bcas pa nyin gcig la stsal bas bdag nyid chen po'i mkhyen rab la der yod kun ha las shing grub pa'i mtshan ma yang dag pa'o zhes chabs cig tu smra bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang sa paṇa dang 'jam dbyangs sbags sgrub/ 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ slob dpon pad+ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ ku ru ku l+le/ dzaṃ dmar lugs gnyis kyi rjes gnang / rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ ri khrod ma/ khro mo rmi brtsegs kyi rjes gnang dbyug gu ma'i man ngag sogs kyi mtshon pa'i dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag rigs gtad la sogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo nyin mtshan med par bskor bar mdzad cing zang zing gi rnyed bkur yang bzhugs ring la chos sde chen por bzang rje'i mang ja bcu phrag gsum la nye ba 'gyed bcas bzang po dang / lhag par rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i dus dran gyi mchod 'bul nyin mang ja nyis sbrel gyis thog bla ma slob dpon sogs zur 'bul 'os pa rnams la mtshan grangs bzang po du ma dang / der tshogs kun la gser 'gyed dang byin rlabs sogs kyi rnyed bkur yang stsal te dge 'dun re rer lo grangs du ma'i 'tsho rkyen phyag tu 'bebs pa mdzad cing / chos rje sa paṇa dang rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i dus chen gyi thebs su gser sogs zang zing gi dngos po rgya chen po yang sbyor bar mdzad de/ mdor na lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas bka' drin chen po stsal bas der bzhugs kun yid rab tu tshim zhing /

da lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos kyis rang re rnams kyi chos kyi dbul ba dus gcig la sel bar mdzad pa'i skal ba bzang po thob zer ba sogs dad zhen lhag par 'phel ba'i rje 'di kho na bsam pa las gzhan mdzad rgyu dang sgrub rgyu gang yang med pa lta bu'i thams cad dam pa 'di nyid la brten bzhugs dang gsol 'debs snyan grags sgrog pa kho nas dus rtag tu 'da' ba kho na byung ba yin no/ /de skabs nyin cig rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung / lam 'bras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bla ma lha khang sogs der yod kyi gtsug lag khang dang / rten gsum khyad par can rnams kyi drung du mchod sprin rgya mtsho lta bu'i bkod pa mtshar du mngar ba dang bcas rim par phebs/ thugs bskyed kyi lhag bsam gsar du tshes pa'i smon lam rgya chen po 'debs pa mdzad cing / khong chos sde ba dpon slob rnams kyis kyang tshes bcu chen mo'i sa ging gnam ging sogs bkod pa ngo mtshar can dang / gur gar gzab ma/ las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i gar 'cham/ zhal bzhi pa'i drag po'i gtor chen sgrub pa'i phyag len gzigs 'bul sogs rnam grangs du ma dang / dge 'dun spyi dang bye brag slob dpon pa so so nas zhabs tog rnyed bkur gyi rim pa rgya dpangs che zhing 'bul nod kyang blo'i ra ba las 'das pa zhig bsgrubs/ lhun grub rab brtan pa sogs skya ser gsum gyis dbang gzhi bting chog pa'i gsol ba btab nas rdo rje gdan pa'i chos khri chen mo'i steng nas dbang mo che lan gnyis stsal te/ de dag gi tshe yang nam mkha' gdugs 'jam zhing 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang 'khrigs pa sogs ngo mtshar can du ma snang ngo / /de nas rje dpon slob rnams rdo rje gdan nas gtsang phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te/ chos rje bka' 'gyur bas gtso mdzad chos sde chen po'i bla ma slob dpon sbyin bdag dpon rigs sogs du mas chibs skyel gzab ma dang bcas rim par phyag phebs te de nub gam pa byang thang du bzhugs shing /

nangs par skyed tshal ba rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i bar lam du stag khu spe chos sde'i bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa rje 'di nyid mjal ba la cher gtad byon te bsnyen bkur 'bul nod rgyas pa dang / der 'dod mthun gyi gsung chos du ma dus gcig la stsal/ de nas skyid tshal ba dpon slob kyis chibs bsu ser 'phreng rgyas pa dang bcas bla brang du spyan drangs te gnas der bzhag gnyis bzhugs pa'i 'du khang chen mor bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa la khong rang rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i rjes gnang byin rlabs rigs gtad lung gi rigs du ma sogs chos kyi rnam grangs mang po dus gcig la stsol bar mdzad/ chos rwa chen mo'i khri steng nas skya ser stong phrag du ma long pa la dbang mo che zhig kyang stsal bas thams cad dga' zhing mgu bar gyur cing / rje nyid kyis kyang chos sder mang ja lnga phrag gcig tsam gnang ba'i thog bsngo rten spyi 'gyed ngal gsos pa'i 'byor pa la co 'dri ba lta bu stsal zhing / khong rnams kyang dad spro'i yid myos par gyur la/ de nas rje dpon slob rags bsdus 'da' gsing la brgyud de yar 'brog dpal sder phebs/ sde pa dpon g.yog rnams kyis chibs bsu zhabs tog rgya che ba bsgrubs/ tshe dbang rjes gnang bsgom lung gi rigs sogs 'dod zhus ltar ci yang zhig stsal/ sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs zhig 'dug pa la phyag nas smin rgyas kyang mdzad de kun gyi mchod yul du mdzad/ de nas yar gzigs su phebs pa'i tshe/ sna dkar rtse nas sde bdag chen po dpon blon/ de phyogs kyi chos sde so so'i bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa zhabs drung du 'byor ste/ khong rnams la thugs 'dod dang mthun pa'i kyai rdo rje'i rgyu dbang / lam dbang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / gur mgon lha brgyad/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra ming sring / dkar bdud lcam dral/ bran bdud sogs zab cing dkon pa'i rjes gnang gi rigs du ma dang /

tshe dbang grub rgyal ma 'chi med dpal ster/ lcags gdong ma sogs tshe dbang gi rigs mang po/ rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ khyung khra/ khyung nag 'jam dbyangs nag po rnams kyi rjes gnang / slob dpon pad+ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung sogs dang / gzhan yang lung gi rigs mang po bcas gnas der zhag gsum bzhugs pa'i ring la nyin mtshan med par chos kyi char chen po phabs pas/ sde pa dpon blon bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa thams cad so sor thugs 'dod tshim zhing mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen pos zhabs tog rnyed bkur 'bul nod kyang lhun po la 'gran pa lta bu phul/ rje nyid kyis kyang mchod yon so sor gnang skyes dang chos grwar mang ja bsngo rten spyi 'gyed sogs lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin gzhal du med pa stsal/ de dus sna dkar rtse dang dpal sde gnyis char du mtsho de'i klu rnams la dge slong bzhi sde res chab gtor klu gtor nyin re bzhin ma chag pa dgos pa'i bka' stsal ltar/ khong rnams kyis phyag bzhes su theb par mdzad/ de nas rong chen brgyud pa gnang ba'i thog mar/ rong ram pa/ dga' bde/ skyid gshong rnams su rim par spyan drangs te/ de dag so so'i rnyed bkur dang zhabs tog sogs ni bsam las 'das/ dkyil khang pa'i bka' 'gyur gsar du bzhengs pa la rab gnas smin rgyas mdzad/ gnas der gong ra dgon pa'i grwa pa mang po zhal mjal gsung thos zhu bar byung ba la so so'i bsam bstun gyi dbang rjes gnang chos kyi bka' drin ci yang zhig stsal zhing / dkyil khang pa sogs skya ser brgya phrag mang po la khrom dbang zhig kyang mdzad de/ der yod kun phan bde'i lam la bkod/ de skabs rtse gdong nas spyan 'dren gyi mi sna dang / gdung brgyud rin po che sku mched la ljags bsnyen gyi stabs lam dbang sogs gsungs/ chos kyi rim pa mang po zhig gnang dgos tshul gyi zhu yig thebs nan 'byor don ltar/

dam pa nyid kyis kyang dges bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes/ de gong dur smrig gi gtsug lag khang dang rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i zhabs rjes sogs la phyag mchod rgyas pa mdzad/ de nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te gzhis kha byams chen pa rnams kyi chibs bshol zhus thog rnyed bkur zhabs tog 'bul ba'i rnam grangs rgya chen po sgrub/ rim gyis rin spungs klu sdings su phebs pa'i tshe/ skye tshal gong nas bla ma grwa rigs kun kyang zhabs drung du 'byor pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor rjes gnang bsgom lung sogs so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun pa bstsal/ rdzong dpon rnams kyis kyang rnyed bkur 'bul ba legs par sgrub/ grwa tshang der mang ja bsngo rten spyi 'gyed sogs zang zing gi dngos po dang / myong grol ril bu'i 'gyed kyang gnang zhing / 'dis tshon pa'i dbus phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i dgon che phra thams cad du dam tshig ril bu bka' drin bskyangs pas re ba'i 'bras bu lan brgyar smin grub yod pa mdzad/ de nas sne bzhi bres gshong / gyer re rnams su rim par phebs/ de'i nangs par rtse gdong nas zhabs drung rin po che rtse rgyas drung 'khor rags bsdus dang bcas pa'i chibs bsu ser 'phreng zab rgyas bcas klu lding du spyan drangs/ der zhag gsum tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la zhabs drung rnams dang / srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa la dpal kyai rdo rje rgyu dbang / lam dbang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang / gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra'i zur ka dkar bdud/ bran bdud sogs chos skyong mang po'i rjes gnang / tshe dbang gi rigs du ma/ khyung khra/ khyung nag 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ sa paṇa sbags sgrub/ lam zab/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung / slob dpon pad+ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ lung gi rigs 'ga' zhig la sogs der bzhugs rnams kyi thugs 'dod dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor bar mdzad cing /

der bzhugs ring zhabs tog rnyed bkur 'bul nod sogs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / der bzhugs rnams la yang byin rlabs rten dang zang zing gi gnang skyes rgya chen pos skal ba bzang po'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzad/ chos sde der yang myong grol ril bu mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs re ba don ldan du mdzad cing / de nas chibs thog khel ba'i mi ring ba zhig gi bar der bzhugs kyi zhabs drung dpon slob kyis chibs skyel mdzad de/ de mtshams nas chibs gyes gnang ba'i zhabs drung dpon slob rnams thugs yid shin tu 'phreng ba'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la rab tu 'dud pas bstan 'gro'i don du skal brgyar zhabs pad brtan pa dang / byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon lam rgya chen po mdzad cing / dam pa 'dis kyang 'phral phugs su dge ba'i bslab ston gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin yang stsal/ gung rtsis thog rta nag sgrol ma ba'i rnyed bkur zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa bskrun/ de nas chos grwa chen po gser mdog can du phebs par nye ba na/ der bzhugs kyi mkhan slob drag 'thus kyis chibs bsu dang / dge 'dun byings kyis ser 'phreng rgyas pas spyan drangs te/ phebs 'phral paṇa chen rin po ches bya rgod phung po'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas par 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sbags sgrub/ 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang sogs gsung chos kyi rim pa stsal zhing / de nub bla brang du gdan chags pa'i nangs par snga bar paṇa chen rin po che sku gdung bzhugs pa'i gdung rten gyi gtsos pa'i lha khang rnams su thugs bskyed smon lam rgya che bar mdzad/ 'du khang chen mor paṇa chen gyi bzhugs khri'i steng nas mkhan slob 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa la paṇa chen nyid la gsol 'debs gsar rtsom gnang ba de nyid kyis mtshon te gsung chos kyi rim pa yang 'ga' zhig stsal/

'dus pa'i tshogs la mang ja 'gyed bcas rgya dpangs che ba dang / myong grol dam tshig ril bu'i 'gyed kyang stsal te khong rnams gus pa lhag par 'phel ba'i snyan grags kyi rnga bo che phyogs kun tu sgrog par gyur cing / de'i nangs par bya rgod phung po'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas skya ser gyi tshogs la khrom dbang zhig kyang stsal/ de 'phral chibs thog khel ba'i rim par phebs pa na/ gzhi ka chen po bsam 'grub rtse nas sa dbang nor bu'i drung gi drung 'khor mang po'i chibs bsu gzab mas spyan drangs te klu lding bkra shis dge tshal du phebs/ der zhag gsum bzhugs pa'i ring la sde srid nor bu'i drung dpon g.yog rags bsdus/ sna dkar chos sde ba rnams dang / 'phyong rgyas 'du khang pa bcas pa'i bla ma 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la so sor thugs 'dod dang bstun pa'i tshe dbang rjes gnang / byin rlabs rigs gtad sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing / dgon so so'i bla ma grwa rigs rnams la mang 'gyed bzang po'i gnang skyes kyang mdzad do/ /de khar mi dbang chen po'i rnyed bkur 'bul nod kyi tshogs rgya chen po phul zhing shin tu gus pa'i zhu gsol mdzad/ rje nyid kyis kyang thugs brtse ba chen pos gnang skyes bslab rten sogs rgyas par stsal bas dpon slob rnams legs tshogs shin tu che ba byung / der bzhugs pa'i nyin gcig bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rin po che dang mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i tshe thugs dag snang chen pos rnyed bkur zhabs tog rgya dpangs shin tu che ba dang / zang zing gi 'bul nod kyang blos dpag par dka' ba zhig sgrub par mdzad/ bdag nyid chen po nas kyang chos grwa de khar mang ja sbyor sbrel 'gyed bcas dang / paṇa chen rin po che'i drung du gya noms pa'i skyes bzang po sgrub par mdzad de/ kun kyang dges shing tshim pa'i legs lam gong 'phel du gyur pa yin la/

de nas snar thang du phebs pa'i tshe de'i grwa tshang so so'i bla ma grwa rigs mi sde dang bcas pa'i zhabs tog rnyed bkur mang du byung zhing / lhag par e waṃ chos ldan nas mkhan rin po che nyid dang klu lding thar pa rtse sogs kyi sku tshab mang po dus gcig la 'dzoms pa'i so so nas zhabs tog 'bul nod rgya chen po phul zhing / dam pa nyid kyis kyang der gnas kyi gzhis byes so sor lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin chen po stsal bas kun kyang gus pa'i sor bcu spyi bor 'god pa la ngal ba lhur len par gyur to/ /de nas glang la brgyud gdan sa chen por ma phebs kyi bar gyi phebs tshigs gang yin dang / khyad par tshal spel shab gzhug gi gnyer bzhugs rgan dmangs rnams dang / 'dra 'dri/ lhun po rtse sogs kyi bla ma grwa rigs/ nang so rgya rgan pa rnams kyis zhabs tog phul du phyin pa mdzad cing / so sor 'dod chos zang zing gi gnang skyes rgya chen pos dga' mgu yid rang par gyur/ de nas 'phyi ba lung du ma phebs kyi bar la/ phu sum chos sde dang / dgon pa rgyas sogs kyi dpon slob grwa btsun dang bcas pas mchod sprin rgya mtsho lta bur skyil/ nangs par 'phyi ba lung nas chibs thog khel ba'i tshe/ rdo rje gdan chen po dpal sa skya nas gang gi gdung sras mtshungs pa ma mchis pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dpon slob rnams kyi gtso mdzad/ chab 'bangs kyi tshogs rnams kyi chibs bsu rgyas pa dang bcas spyan drangs te rim gyis gdan sa chen por phebs nye ba na/ der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyi ser 'phreng gzab ma/ 'cham mgon byin rlabs can rnams kyis bsu ba/ skyes dang bud med rnams kyis gzhas rtsed rgyan gos gzab ma sogs ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas pa'i sku mdun nas bsus te/ hor lugs zla ba bzhi pa'i dmar phyogs bzang po thog ma'i tshes la/ rje btsun gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams dang /

rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyi bsti gnas dam pa dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du legs par phebs te/ rgyal bstan rin po spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa srid mtha'i bar du nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad/ lhun grub mi 'gyur dpal gyi bsam yas zhes/ /bsrung ba'i mel tshe mthun ldan rtse dmar gyis/ /mgon khyod bstan gyi dpung du ring nas bkug /las bzhi spel ba'i srog la mdud pa bcas/ 1 /gnas der lus med yid can bcu phrag gsum/ /rnam grol mchog gi go 'phang la bkod pa'i/ /rdo rje rnam rgyal sa yi tshangs pa ches/ /khyod zhabs spyi bo'i gtsug tu gus pas bsten/ 2 /gzhan yas sdom brtson rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rje/ /dpal ldan bdud 'joms gnyis pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /gang gi bsti gnas dbus ru rdo rje gdan/ /der 'dus 'phral yun phan bde'i lam la bkod/ 3 /mdor na dbus 'gyur 'dus tshogs grangs yas la/ /smin grol lung gi bka' drin mtha' yas shing / /rin chen sa le sbram sogs gnang skyes kyi/ /lo re'i dbul ba 'gog pa'i 'tsho ba sbyar/ 4 /'dus byas dge rtsa grangs med gsum gyi tshogs/ /skad cig nyid la rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /byin rlabs mtshan ma bzang po'i rgyud phyug par/ /byas nas chibs kyi kha lo gtsang du bsgyur/ 5 /de lta'i rmad byung legs byas dpag med kyis/ /rgyal bstan nyin mo'i snang ba 'bar bzhin du/ /'gro la rjes chags gzugs sku'i snang brnyan mchog /dpal ldan sa skyar chos srid nyi ma shar/ 6 /de'i nang par nas brtsams mgon khang so sor gtang rag gi bskang gso rgyas pa mdzad cing / de nas zla ba lnga pa'i rje mus chen gyi sku mchod dang / zla ba drug pa'i sa lo chen po'i dus chen sgrub mchod sogs kyi tshogs dbur phebs/ zla ba de'i mjug tsam la yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi thugs bzhed kyi lhag ma bskang ba'i phyir dang /

bstan pa spyi sger gyi 'phel rgyas la dgongs gur gyi mgon po lha bcu gnyis ma/ ru 'dren sde bzhi/ zhing skyong tsa turmu kha bram ze'i gzugs can/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ dmag zor rgyal mo/ dkar bdud lcam dral dang bcas pa'i 'bur sku mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog par byed pa 'di rnams kyi gca' gzhi sgrig par mdzad pa dang lhan cig sku mdun bod gong pa sogs lha bris pa rnams la bzhugs gral thog bslab ston zhib rgyas zhig gnang ste/ de yang gdan sa chen po 'di nyid bla ma gong ma'i byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas mchog tu gyur pa chos skyong rnams sprin phung 'thib pa lta bur bzhugs pa yin kyang / bse mgon yid bzhin nor bu tsam las bka' gtod bran g.yog dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa cha tshang ba zhig gi 'bur sku ma byung 'dug pa nas gdan sa 'dir cha tshang ba zhig med mthu med yin 'dug pa/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i bka' bzhin mkhyen brtse chen mo'i phyag sor gyis bskrun par mdzad pa'i gur gyi mgon po ru 'dren dang bcas pa gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi 'di rnams shin tu legs shing skabs dang 'brel ba byung 'dug pa ltar/ da lam khyed rnams kyis kyang nged kyi ngag bzhin 'phral du bsgrub dgos tshul dang / lhag par bka' bsgo zhabs dbang sogs kyi rgyun byin gyis brlabs te khong rnams kyang gus spro chen pos zla ba bdun pa'i dkar phyogs kyi gza' tshes bzang ba la las 'go btsugs ste bka' bzhin rtag 'grus su sgrub par mdzad/ de mtshams nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyi sku mchod rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod chen mo gnang grub bstun/ byang nas bdag po bla ma'i drung / gong dkar nas sog po bla ma sogs gzhis byes kyi chos nyan pa rags bsdus zhig la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid dang / de'i yig skor gsar snying mang po zhig gi lung /

rje nyid kyi rtogs brjod ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs kyi sgra dbyangs skal bzang dpyid kyi dga' ston sogs chos kyi bdud rtsi ci yang zhig stsal rjes/ gser mdog can nas mkhan rin po che dpon slob rags bsdus zhig zhabs drung du 'byor pa las/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa spyi dang / khyad par paṇa chen nas brgyud pa 'di deng sang gzhan su la yang bzhugs pa zhig mi 'dug pa bcas bka' drin bskyang dgos tshul gyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ gdung sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug lcam sring dang / gdung brgyud rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis yab yum sras rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dir bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rags rim gsol ba 'debs pa po rnams dang / sgom sde nang chen nas chos rje bla ma'i dbon rigs rje nyid kyis lung bstan bzhin dgon pa gsar rgyag gegs med du thar phyin pa'i legs so 'bul bar grwa rigs mang po dang bcas 'byor pa de dag dang / gzhan yang glo bo smon thang pa'i grwa rigs du ma/ rnam rgyal lha rtse/ mnga' ris/ nyi shar chos sde/ thub bstan rnam rgyal/ ngor dgon pa/ nā len+d+ra sogs nas 'dus pa'i gzhis byes kyi chos nyan pa brgya phrag du ma la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa/ de dang 'brel ba'i dbang rjes gnang / lung man ngag cha lag so so ma tshang ba med pa sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi bar du smin rgyas su zla ba du ma'i bar stsal te/ der 'dus thams cad dad pa dang blo gros kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas par gyur pa yin la/ lo de'i dgun bzang ldan chos sde'i slob dpon pa chen po mdo dang rgyud sde kun la mkhyen pa'i spyan ras gsal ba byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal bas gsol btab pa'i ngor gdung sras dam pa rnams dang / gzhis byes kyi bla ma grwa rigs mang po la sa skya pa'i kyai rdo rje bka' babs bzhi'i gzhung 'grel la rten pa gsum gyi/

rgya gzhung gi rigs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa deng sang lung rgyun chad la thug pa'i shin tu dkon pas gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu dang / 'jig byed ra lugs kyi rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi khrid/ de'i yig skor gyi lung / 'jig byed rwa lugs/ rwa khrid/ mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud kyi khrid/ yig brgya'i lung dang bcas pa 'bri khung dpal 'dzin gyis bsgrigs pa'i 'jigs byed kyi man ngag be'u bum rnams shin tu rgyas shing mtha' chod pa'i bka' drin stsal/ de nas bsgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag lo dam pa 'di nyid dgung gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag drug dang nyag ma gsum du phebs pa hor lugs zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du gur gyi mgon po ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i snang brnyan shin tu legs shing gzi brjid ldan pa 'di rnams mthar thon te mtshan srid gsum zil gnon du gsol bar mdzad cing / mgon khang de'i phyogs bzhi bar mtshams med par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyis phyag bris gur zhal pu tra sogs kyi bris thang byin rlabs can du ma gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam gyi rten phyag dris ma sogs bris thang byin rlabs can du mas khyab pa dang / gzhan yang sku gsung thugs gyi rten phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig sbyor bar mdzad pas rgyas par ni de nyid kyi dkar chag tu gsal zhing / zla ba de'i nyer gsum la rab tu gnas pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa smin rgyas su mdzad/ gzhan yang phyag nas smin rgyas yang yang mdzad pas ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bzhugs pa'i rtags su mgon khang der su zhig gis phyin kyang sleb ma thag 'jigs shing skyi phung byed pa dang / tha mal gyi rnam rtog phra rags rnams 'gags nas sku rnams la lta mi nus bzhin du dal bus ltas pa na/ sku rnams shin tu legs shing yid rang dbang med par 'phrog cing blo phebs te chos skyong ye shes pa dngos rnams la yang 'di bas lhag pa med do snyam pa'i dang ba'i dad pa dang byin rlabs rmad du byung ba gzhan las ches lhag pa 'di ni sngon med gsar du bskrun par mdzad pa yin la/

de nas 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i sku gdung ril po bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bu sngon du mdzad zin pa la hor lugs zla ba dang po'i nang du ldebs bris dus mchod gdung brgyud rim par byon pa'i brgyud rim dang / sku gdung rin po che bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la grang gser rjib gtong gi zhabs tog gnam rgyan bya spu dkar nag kho na las grub pa'i bla bre khyad 'phags gzhan yang bkras thags dang rgyan gzhi sogs khyad gos kho na bsgrigs pa'i ka star gsum gyi bar tal ma'i bla bre dang / sa rgyan mchod pa'i bye brag kyang gsar pa mang du 'bul ba mdzad cing rab gnas smin rgyas su sgrub par mdzad de/ deng sang kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i gnas su gyur pa 'di nyid dang / zur khang du rje btsun rin po che'i sku 'dra rin po che la hor gos kyi sku ber/ ka star gsum la khyad gos kho na bsgrigs pa'i bla bre/ phyogs mtshams kun la lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can du mas mdzes par byas shing / mchod pa'i bye brag kyang mang po gsar du 'bul ba mdzad nas/ gtsug lag khang 'di la yang zhabs tog gsar bzhengs lta bu'i sgo nas da lta kun kyis mthong ba tsam gyis dang ba'i dad pa dbang med du bskyed par byed pa 'di nyid yin la/ de nas lo de'i zla ba gsum pa'i nang du nyis thog bla brang du gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs bca' sgrig gi zhal bkod thog mar mdzad pa'i nyin glo bur du a tsa ra zhig gis 'jam dpal na ga rag sha'i sku li ma ya mtshan can zhig dang / zhal bzhi pa'i rten rdo kho rang rtsis shin tu che zhing tsa turmu kha zer ba dang bcas sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid kyi phyag tu 'byor pas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'dug gsungs shing thugs dges spro dang bcas phyag tu bzhes/ gzhan yang de skabs rten 'brel ngo mtshar can mang po zhig dang / rje nyid rang la mtshan ltas khyad par can mang du byung ba rnams ni thun mong du bri bar ma nus so/

/slar zla ba drug pa'i nang du gtsug lag khang yongs su rdzogs pa grub cing / gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin rje nyid rang gi gzim chung na yod pa'i rten byin rlabs can rnams dang / rten gyi gtso bo la rje btsun brtse ba chen po'i sku brnyan mi tshad tsam zhig gsar du bzhengs par mdzad de/ rgya bod kyi bla ma gong ma mang po zhig gi sku gsung thugs kyi rten byin rlabs can mang po'i 'phyur bur bltams pas/ da lta mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa gsol ba btab na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa 'di nyid dang / nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa mchod dpon smon lam rin chen pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bka'i gnang ba thob ste/ rje btsun dam pa rang nyid kyi sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba rnams dang / sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa dang bcas bde ldan mngon dgar mtshan gsol te skal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du 'gro ba rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bskrun par mdzad do/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che sogs bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam 'cham mgon lcam dral bcu gcig gi gsol phod dang / rdo rje gong pa rnams khyad gos kho nas gsar du spo ba mdzad cing / lo de'i zla ba bzhi pa'i mgo tsam la thub bstan yangs pa can gyi slob dpon pa gnyis kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rigs kyi cod pan 'dzin pa'i gdung sras ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis sras yum gyi gtsos pa'i gzhis byes kyi grwa bu slob mang ba zhig la gur gyi mgon po'i gsang khrid rgyas pa cha lag dang bcas pa/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid/ 'brug lugs kyi nā ro chos drug ro snyom sgang sgril sogs kyi khrid/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ sum pa lo tsā nas brgyud pa'i khrid zab mo/ jo bo thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes su gnang ba/

khrid so so'i yig cha'i lung la sogs pa'i chos kyi char chen pos 'gro ba dpag tu med pa sngon du 'dren par mdzad zin pa dang / da lta 'dren par mdzad pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'dren par mdzad par 'gyur ba'i gsung chos kyi tha ma de nyid la gnang / de skabs nas sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs sngags 'chang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'grel nang bzhin rgyal ba'i skyes rabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa thog tshad ma nyi shu rtsa dgu gser thang 'ba' zhig tu sgrub par mdzad pa dang / de thams cad la gong gsham 'ja' ris gsum sbrag hor gos khyad 'phags 'ba' zhig las grub pa/ zhal kheb lnga brtsegs/ sgril shing gi tog thad gser dngul 'jang brdung kho na las grub pa sogs gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa 'di rnams ljags bkod gnang ba sogs rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las rgya chen pos rgyal bstan rin po che spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams shing rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel thams cad yang dag par bsgrigs par mdzad pa yin no/ /smras pa/ mdzad pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su lhun chags pa'i/ /rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las nyin mo'i mgon/ /rgyal bstan pad tshal bzhad dang lhan cig tu/ /thub bstan sa chen mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur/ /yongs 'du'i shing dang dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /rang rang re ba'i 'bras bu rtag 'jo ba'i/ /gang la ci dgos chos can gzigs pa yis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro 'di bdag gir mdzad min nam/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i skye ba'i 'phreng ba yis/ /sku brnyan rin chen las grub bcu phrag gnyis/ /dgu yis lhag pa'i byin rlabs dri bsung can/ /lha mi'i bsod nams zhing du legs par bskrun/ /bzhi pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad rjes/ zhing khams gzhan du 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa ches cher yangs par gzigs nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su ji ltar bsdu ba mdzad pa'i tshul ni/

zhing 'dir ma lus gdul bya'i don sgrub nas/ /gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings ngang du bsdus/ /rmad byung ltas mchog ngo mtshar grangs yas sprul/ /'phrin las rgyun mi chad la slar yang 'dud/ /zhes te/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid gdung gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag drug dang nyag gsum du phebs pa sa mo phag lo ma rdzogs kyi bar du bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam bsgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum spel mar mdzad pas grub bstan spyi dang / bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che nam langs pa la nyin byed dbang po shar ba ltar gyur pas shin tu thugs dges pa chen po dang ldan cing / snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo rnams kyi spyod tshul ngan pa dag gzigs pas thugs cung zad gdung bar yang gyur nas/ bla ma lha yi lung bstan bzhin zhing khams dag pa gzhan du gshegs pa la thugs mngon du phyogs par gyur te/ de yang rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid dgung gi grangs lnga bcu rtsa lngar phebs pa bong bu zhes pa lcags mo yos lo hor zla drug pa'i nang du dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu sgrub par mdzad pas gnam gang gi tho rangs mtshan lam du/ rje nyid bde mchog pho brang du phebs nas/ de na bzhugs pa'i dkar po rnam gsum gyi sku brnyan de rnams la gus pa'i sgo nas legs par gzigs pas/ de rnams zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad cing / phyag brkyang bskum dang / sku yang sgul skyod sna tshogs mdzad pa snyam byed/ de nas thugs dad pa cher g.yos te/ khyed kyis mi mkhyen pa'am mi gzigs pa ci yang ma mchis pas/ bdag gi tshe ji tsam thub dang phyi mar gar skye ba'i lung bstan gsal bar stsal du gsol zhes zhu bar mdzad pa na/ dbus kyi sa chen gyi sku de da lta'i bde mchog pho brang gi sku brnyan gsar pa de min pa'i sku 'dra rnying ma mi tshad tsam cig tu gyur nas/ sku g.yas 'og tu bcug ste gzim stabs log ge ba'i ngang nas/

rje nyid la gsang gros kyi tshul du/ tshe ni 'jal byed gser ris 'khyud pa'i 'byung ba nyis 'gyur du thub bo zhes gsal bar gsungs shing / phyi ma rig pa 'dzin pa 'grub bo gsung ba snyam mdzad pa na mnal sad de/ bag chags sam lung bstan ci yin yang rmi lam ya mtshan che dgongs pa 'khrungs shing 'dug pa/ nang par bdag sogs sku 'khor ba rnams la yang de bzhin gyi bka' stsal byung zhing / lhag par mkhan rin po che mkhas pa'i dbang po bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ba zhabs drung du phebs pa zhig la bka' las/ nged la bag chags sam lung bstan ci yin yang kha sang gnam gang gi tho rangs rmi lam 'di bzhin byung ba/ tshe ni 'jal byed gser ris 'khyud pa'i 'byung ba nyis 'gyur thub zer ba des brda' don gser ris 'khyud pa'i lhun po lta bu'i lus rten 'di'i 'jal byed dam tshad ni 'byung ba ste lnga nyis 'gyur bcu thub zer rgyu yin 'dug gsung ba la/ mkhan rin po che nyid nas sku tshe'i tshad sogs lung bstan de bzhin shin tu ngo mtshar che zhing bslab ston gron med du phebs pa bka' drin shin tu che/ brda' don kyang 'byung ba nyis 'gyur bcu/ de steng gser ri bdun bsnan pa'i bcu bdun nges par bzhugs pa'i thugs 'dun cis kyang bka' drin che dgos shing / de bzhin thugs 'dun ma dor ba'i snyel tho zhig kyang gnang dgos zhu ba mdzad 'dug pa la/ 'dun pa byas pa'i steng du 'gro ba lkog 'dug na'ang / bcu bdun sdod pa'i rten 'brel gang 'grig byed gsungs shing / snyel tho zhig 'debs par mdzad pa la yang bcu bdun 'jug par mdzad pa gong bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs na gsal ba ltar lags/ mi mkhas pa dag gong gsal snyel tho 'debs par mdzad pa dang 'di skabs lung bstan rnams 'gal lo snyam na/ bshad ma thag pa yin mod/ de dag ni drang nges kyi rnam gzhag so sor ma phyed pa'i skyon te/

dang po ni mkhan rin po che sogs gdul ba kha drang pa'i ched du gsungs pa dang / phyi ma ni sgra ji bzhin pa ste/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba las/ sangs rgyas gsung la drang don dang / /nges don rnam pa gnyis su yod/ /sgra yang ji bzhin pa dang ni/ /ji bzhin min pa gnyis su gsungs/ /theg pa yang ni 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten 'das pa gnyis su gnas/ /bshad pa yang ni dgongs pa dang / ldems por dgongs dang drang po ru/ /dgongs pa zhes bya rnam gsum yod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyis rnam par dbye ba so sor 'byed dgos pas so/ /de ltar lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa nas bcu 'das pa na zhing khams dag pa gzhan du gshegs pa la thugs sngon du phyogs par gyur te/ de'i snga ltas su de'i gong bdag nyid chen po 'di phra rags kyi bya ba dang / 'phrin las gang sgrub na'ang thugs ngang shin tu ring ba zhig yin pa la/ de lo nas brtsams gzhis byes kyi bla ma slob dpon mang po dang / khyad par rigs dang chos las 'khrungs pa'i thugs sras mchog tu gyur pa dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po yab sras sogs skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos ma dor ba'i dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba mdzad pa thams cad ma grub dogs pa lta bu'i thugs rtsol kho na mdzad pa dang / sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs su yang dge 'dun rnams gung tshigs thog chos nyan pa gzhan rnams kyang bsdu ba mdzad nas gsung chos kho nas dus 'da' ba dang / gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas par yang zhig bzos nyams gso gsar du bskrun pa sogs mdzad pa gang dang ci mchis pa thams cad gang myur myur gyis zhes yang yang bka' stsal phebs pa sogs la rjes su dpag na/ zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa mkhyen cing dgongs pa'i bka' lung kho nar gnang zhing /

ltos bcas kyi gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse bas de bar zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa ma gtogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du phebs pa'i thugs 'dun snga gong nyid nas mdzad zin par mngon no/ /de dag la 'di skad/ 'gro ba'i bla mas nye ba'i rim gro bar/ /myang 'das zhi bar bzhugs la dges pa'i gtam/ /yang yang bsgrags kyang lus med gzhan dbang las/ /kun dga' bo de rtog brjod dran pa gtor/ /bla ma lha yi lung bstan mngon gyur zhing / /ngan spyod mang pos dam pa'ang bsun 'byin pas/ /zhing 'dir khrel nas zhing gzhan phebs spro ba'i/ /gsung 'ga' byon mod yid srub 'thib kyis non/ /de ltar mchog gi 'dren pa dam pa de nyid nges pa'i don du dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa'i chos kyi sku sngon du mdzad zin pas skye 'jig gi spros pa nye bar zhi yang / gzhan snang kun rdzob tu gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa sna tshogs su ston pa rgyal ba rnams kyi spyi lugs yin pa bzhin dgung gi grangs drug cu re gsum pa sa mo phag gi lo snron zla ba'i skyed tsam nas cung zad bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan pa las don du sku zungs zhan pa tsam la brten pa'i skabs 'ga' der sku zer spun tsam yong ba zhig las mnyel rgyu cher ma byung bas/ thugs dam zab mo la brtse gcig tu bzhugs shing thun mtshams rnams la gsung rtsom 'phro can rnams kyang grub par mdzad/ sku drung na yod pa'i phyag dpe rnams la gdong dar glegs thag sogs khyad gos 'ba' zhig las grub pa 'bul ba mdzad de/ da tshe 'dir dpe 'di rnams la bed spyod pa zhig yong ba mi 'dug na'ang / dpe khang chen mor bla ma gong ma'i phyag dpe rnams kyi grab la gcig kyang ma lus pa skyel ba gyis/ phyir mi 'khyar pa'i 'phrin las chos skyong la bcol yod pas rjes 'jug rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa na nged rang gi bed chod pa yang srid gsung / sku la bsnyun gzhi che ba med pas sman dpyad sogs kyis 'jug che ba ma byung yang /

rjes 'jug rnams bsod nams gsog pa dang gzhan gyi kha na ma tho ba'i brjod pa spang ba'i phyir 'tsho byed mkhas pa zung gi 'phrod rten sna re tsam gyi ngo bstun pa dang / sku rim gyi tshul yang ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin sgrub chog pa rjes su gnang ba ltar dbus gtsang gi dgon rigs su ma bcad pa bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig la mang ja 'gyed bcas stobs che ba yang yang gnang zhing / gdan sa 'di nyid rang du yang nye skor gyi dge 'dun rnams bsdu bar mdzad pa'i zhal grangs stong phrag brgal bar rnyed bkur 'bul 'gyed rgya chen po dang bcas rgyun ma chad par bsgrubs/ gzhan yang chos sde lho byang gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhis byes kyi grwa bu slob sde dpon skya ser bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gi skal brgyar zhabs pad brtan pa'i thugs mdun rtse gcig pas nyin mtshan 'khor mor gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pa'i bzhugs gdan gyi rigs kyang brgya phrag du ma long ba byung mod gdul bya rnams las dang skal ba dang ldan na ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlob nus kyang / lus can rnams kyi bsod nams la ma dbang pa'i sku khams la skyed thon pa'i bka' chos 'chad nyan gnang ba dang / tshul sgrub mchod sogs la phebs thub pa'i sangs dwangs zhig ma byung zhing / bka' las kyang ma shi bar rong ston chos rje dang sngags 'chang chen po bzhin chos 'chad nyan dang bla ma gong ma'i dus dran gyi sgrub mchod 'di rnams la ngos rang 'gro thub pa byed snyam pa yod kyang / na tshod dang lus zungs 'di yang gzhan du ka 'gro ba zhig 'dug pas/ da rang bstan pa'i bya ba de tsam yin 'dug cing / ma grub snyam pa'i 'gyod pa yang cher med/ lo gzhon nu nas chos la dag snang che ba byas pas bla ma rnams kyi spyan 'bras lta bu nged kho na dgongs pa mdzad/ nged rang gis kyang so so'i bka' bzhin bstan pa rin po che'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum la ngal ba lhur len bgyis pas da bar skye 'gro la yang phan pa mang dag byung /

chos thob pa thams cad kyang mos blor ma lus pa gdul bya rang rang gi blo dang mthun pa ci dgos shod thub pa dang / lhag par chos rgyun dkon pa 'di rnams yang yang spel thub cing / sngags 'chang chen po'i bstan pa'i rgyun 'di yang yar ldan kho na byung bas skal ba bzang zhing blo bde gsung / yang skabs 'gar na rgyu che ba mi 'dug na'ang bstan pa'i bya ba mi thub pa'i lus rten 'di rjes pa legs pa 'dug gsung ba sogs dag zhing gzhan du phebs spro ba'i bka' stsal kho na gnang ba byung / de mtshams skabs zhig e waṃ chos ldan gyi chos grwa chen po 'dzin skyong spel gsum la mtshungs pa med pas spyan ras kyi gzigs pa nam mkha' ltar yangs pa mkhan rin po che bsod nams rgya mtsho ba rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i chos kyi khri ga la ba der 'khod pa'i thog ma'i phyag 'bul zhu bar zhabs drung du 'byor/ phebs ma thag dges bzhin du zhal mjal phyag dbang sogs bka' drin bskyangs/ da lam khyed 'dir 'byon thub pa de skabs mtshams zin pa byung / ngor dgon pa 'di nyag phra ba'i skabs thams cad du nged rang gi bsam bzang khur bskyed pa'i snga sor yang phan sleb che ba kho na byung zhing / da lam yang nged kyi mthun grogs rgyal dbang nas mdzad pa'i chos khri stong par rgyun ring 'jog ma dgos pas mkhan po 'phral du 'khod pa shin tu legs tshogs che/ rdo rje 'chang yab sras nas/ rje btsun gong ma'i bar gyi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa thams cad dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs yod pas rang re thams cad skal ba bzang / da bstan pa la thugs 'khur yag po bskyed dgos so gsungs zhing / dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bslab ston mang po zhig dang gnang skyes rgya che ba gnang / de skabs kyang zhing gzhan du phebs pa'i bka' stsal kho na gnang 'dug yang skabs zhig lha khang chen mo nas gling tshang mthun sdebs dang /

spyi pa las tshan sogs sger dag nas brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs zhu mi mang ba byung bar/ bzhugs gdan rnams stabs gcig tu phul bas 'di rnams ci yin gsungs/ chos sde'i grwa pa rnams kyi gling tshang so so dang sger nyis 'thu gsum 'thu mdzad pa nas brten bzhugs gsol 'debs kho na mdzad kyi yod 'dug pa nas/ de rnams kyi bzhugs gdan yin 'dug lags zhus pas/ grwa pa 'di rnams kyi snga phyir nged kho na bsam pa byas/ da lam yang do gal che ba de bzhin yod pa yin/ nged la phan pa cher med na'ang kho rang tshor bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs 'jug gsungs/ de bstun sku gzengs gnang ba dang spyan khra khor khor ba'i ngang nas rje btsun gong ma tsho dpon slob thams cad dag pa'i zhing du drongs shig gsung ba sogs lan du ma'i bar du gnang ba byung / gzhan yang de lta'i skabs thams cad du sku zungs zhan pa tsam las bsnyun gyi rnam pa gang yang med pas dus skabs phal che ba thugs dam zab mo 'ba' zhig la rtse gcig tu bzhugs shing / skabs 'gar gzigs snang khyad par can mang po zhig yod pa'i nyams kyi bka' lung gsal po min pa thor tsam gnang ba zhig dang khyad par nub gcig sa sros mtshams sku 'khor na yod pa rnams kyi da cha sa yang sros 'dug pas gzim chung steng du phebs ran 'dug lags zhus pas/ khyed rang rnams kyang 'di khar 'dug la lhod tsam gyis gsungs pa'i mu nas/ nga 'das pa'i rjes su me tog gi char kha ba 'bab 'bab yong ba 'dug kha ba 'bab 'bab yong ba 'dug gsung ba nyis bstud zhig gnang ba dang / spyan bar snang la khor khor gzigs pa zhig mdzad byung bas gzigs snang khyad par can zhig byung ba mngon du gyur kyang sku zil ches pa dang / rang nyid spob pa zhan pas gang yang zhu ma spob/ de nas gzim chung du phebs zhabs 'chag pa dang sku byug gnang ba sogs sngar rgyun ltar bka' drin bskyangs pas nyin re tsam ma gtogs gnas skabs thams cad du gsol spyod mi 'da' ba'i rigs gtan nas ma byung zhing /

thugs rig kyang dang ba kho na byung / de skabs zla ba bcu pa tsam la/ sde bdag nor bu'i drung zhang tshan gzhis ka rtser glo bur du phebs pa'i rkyen byas gtsang dbus kyi mi rnams 'khrug rtsod sna tshogs byung bar skye 'gro bde ba'i thugs skyed rmad du byung bas/ mkhan rin po che dpon slob chings kyi bka' 'doms su rdzongs rta gnang / de nas hor lugs zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes nas brtsams sku zungs je zhan la 'gro ba zhig byung bas gzhan ma bya thabs ma rnyed/ tshogs chen mor dga' ston zhig btang chog pa'i snyan 'bul phyag mdzod nas zhu bar mdzad pa la/ rang re dpon slob thams cad kyi bsags sbyang yin pas de bzhin cis kyang legs/ de thog rje btsun gong ma'i sku brnyan rnams la nged rang gi snam sbyar dang cha ru dngos gtsang ba 'di rnams 'bul ba'i bkod khyab gyis phebs 'dug cing / de nas tshes lnga yi nub sku zer mtho bas mnal phebs lkog pa tsam byung / de'i nang par 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog tu gyur pa rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gtso mdzad/ rdo rje slob bu nyung shas la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i lung bstan pa dang / rjes su gnang ba'i sgo nas bstan pa rin po che spyi dang khyad par sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa dag ji ltar 'dzin zhing skyong ba dang spel ba'i tshul rnams legs par gsung zhing / tshes bdun gyi nyin sku brnyan rnams la 'bul rgyu'i na bza' rnams la zhal yig gsung rtsom gnang ste/ de yang chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i drung du na bza' 'di'i tshon pa'i dus gsum gyi dge bas sa skya pa ā nan+da tshe 'di 'phos 'phral dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas sa lam skad cig la bgrod de/ slar yang sprul pas bstan pa rin po che dkar 'jam du bya nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig gsung ba sogs sku brnyan so sor rigs 'gre sbyor rgyu'i bka' rtsom gyi tha ma de la gnang /

de rjes phyag mdzod sku gzhogs su phebs pa la phyogs la zur bstan gyi bka' tshig mang po zhig dang / lhag par dga' ston sbyin gtong 'di tshes bcu la nges par yong ba gyis gsung ba sogs 'phral phugs su dge ba'i bslab ston lung bstan ci yang stsal 'dug pa la/ phyag mdzod nyid kyis de bzhin gyi bka' stsal mi gnang ba'i ngos bstan 'gro'i don du skal brgyar zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs zhu bas thugs 'dun kho na bka' drin che dgos/ ci lte gsol ba ma thebs tshe bka' stsal bslab ston gyi tshogs ci nas kyang dang len kho na zhu bas bstan pa dang sems can thugs brtse bas ma dor ba dang / bdag sogs skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin pa cis kyang bka' drin che dgos zhu bar mdzad 'dug pa la khyed rnams nam yang brjed mi yong gsung ba sogs rjes su 'dzin pa'i bka' stsal lhug par phebs/ tshes drug nas bcu'i bar la sku bde nyams che ba kho na byung bas sku gzhug na gnas pa rnams kyang blo bag phebs pa tsam byung / yin yang skabs 'gar dri bzang po zhig thul thul byed pa dang / dgongs gtad kyang zhing khams gzhan du snang ba rang zhig 'dug pas/ mchod dpon lags sogs bdag sku 'khor na yod pa rnams kyis kyang deng sang sku yang zor yang che ba 'dug lags cing / phyi nang gi rten 'brel rnams kyang mi legs pa mi 'dug pa dang / lhag par bsam yas chos skyong nas kyang dge bshes rang gi thugs 'dun gnang tshe nyes pa'i skyon med zhu ba kho na byung bas bstan pa spyi sger la dgongs nas zhabs kyi pad+mo yun ring brtan pa'i thugs 'dun bka' drin che dgos zhus pas/ bka' las chos 'chad nyan byed pa dang bla ma gong ma'i dus dran gyi mchod 'bul la yang 'gro ma thub pa zla ba kha shas song / da lus rten 'dis bstan pa'i bya ba thub pa zhig mi yong ba 'dug pas/ bstan pa'i bya ba mi thub pa'i lus rten 'phos pa rang legs pa 'dug gsung ba dang /

gzhan yang bka' stsal mang po zhig gnang byung ba'i phros la/ ka ba 'di'i mdun du btsun ma gcig snga gong nas da lta'i bar du yang yang yong ba zhig 'dug mkha' spyod ma yin pa 'dra/ gzhan yang sngas mgo 'di'i shar phyogs su bram ze gcig dang / de'i nub tu btsun pa gcig yong gi 'dug pa 'di rnams zhal bzhi pa dang pu tra yin pa 'dra gsung shing / gzhan yang 'di'i mtshon pa'i rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod na'ang dam pa gang gi bka'i gnang ba ma thob pa dang chos skyong bka' gnyan pas thun mong du 'dri bar ma spobs so/ /de nas tshes bcu'i thugs dam ljags bzlas kyi rim pa rnams gtor bsngo yi bar sngar ltar rgyas pa gnang rjes/ gtor ma 'bul grab gyis gsung ba dang lhan cig gtor ma rnams la phyag mdzub mdzad de/ bde kyai gsang gsum la sogs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i dngos po rnams kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bur gyur nas skal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du rgyun ma chad pa 'bul bar bgyi'o gsungs nas/ smon lam dang 'phrin bcol mang dag zhig gnang / de rjes nas 'di gnang gi bka' cung zad tsam yang mi stsal ba rje btsun sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya mang po zhig gnang rjes/ da tshogs chen mo gyes a song gsungs cung ma gyes 'dug lags zhus pas thugs dam de kha'i ngang la bzhugs/ de mtshams nas tshogs pa rnams kyis bkra shis mjug gi ki sgra mdzad byung ba na da grol ba yin 'dug gsungs/ thugs dges nyams shin tu che ba gcig mdzad pa sogs zhing khams 'di'i mdzad pa re zhig de tsam gyis rdzogs pa dang / zhing khams gzhan du 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa ches cher yong ba la dgongs nas/ rtag 'dzin can rnams nges 'byung bskyed pa dang / le lo can rnams brtson 'grus la bskul ba'i ched du lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten ma lus pa'i skyabs dang /

mgon dang / dpung gnyen mchog tu gyur pa de nyid dgung gi grangs drug cu re bzhir phebs pa yongs su grags pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum stong bdun brgya dgu bcu go bzhir slebs pa mgo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu'i srod kyi cha la rje btsun grags pa'i 'phel gdung dang sngags 'chang chen po'i dam rdzas zhig bsres la khur shog gsungs/ gsol grub 'phral zhabs rdo rje skyil krung / phyag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur thugs khar bsnol/ sku rgyab phyogs su cung zad bsnyes tsam gyi ngang nas rgyud sde rin po che nas gsungs pa'i 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor gsal 'debs mdzad de hig che ba gnyis dang chung ngu gcig gnang ste/ thun mong du snang ba'i gzugs sku'i snang brnyan mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'phro ba de chos dbyings 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings su mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul bstan/ de ltar tshes bcu nas bcu gnyis kyi tho rangs kyi bar du 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag de'i tshe rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtags 'di lta bu'o zhes 'jig rten kun la ched du ston pa bzhin du de nyin nas brtsams nam mkha' g.ya' yongs su dag pa la dbang po'i gzhu ris gsar pa gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs kyi dbyibs 'dra ba'i 'phreng ba mtshar du mngar bas khyab par brel/ tha mal gyi rlung rdul ngang gis zhi/ dri bzhon gyi rgyu ba tsam yang rgyun ring po'i bar du chad/ nyin byed kyang ches gsal ba dang lha rnams kyi mngon par gtor ba'i me tog gi char bsil mar 'bab cing sngar tshor ma myong ba'i dri bzang pos khyab pa dang / dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rol mo'i sgra yang skabs 'gar 'byung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang mtshan ma ci yang zhig byung bas de skabs gtsang dbus zir bun gyis stabs/

gzhan gyi kha na ma tho ba'i smra ba spong ba'i phyir re zhig gsang ba'i dam tshig byas kyang rtogs spyod che ba rnams kyis ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rnams la rjes su dpag nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs par go ba yang mang du byung ba sogs skal ba dang ldan pa kun gyi thugs mtshor tshang ba de lags/ de nas tshes bcu gnyis kyi tho rangs kyi cha la bab pa na 'od gsal las zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs te dbu'i gtsug tor sor gang tsam zhig mchog tu 'phags te byang sems kyi zil pa khrom me ba dang bcas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas sku mdun nas bsus te shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i drung du gshegs te rgyal ba thams cad kyi mdzad pa dus gcig la bsdus par gyur to/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal bas phyag len mdzad de he badz+ra nas bshad pa'i cho gas sku gdung rin po che la chas gzhug gi zhabs tog phul te dri bzang dar zab la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang lha rdzas kyi na bza'i tshogs du mas bkur bsti chen por byed nas gdung sgrom gyi khrir mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa'i dbus su bsod nams kyi zhing dam par re zhig bzhugs su gsol zhing / rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs sku gzhogs pa rnams kyis rgyud sde rin po che nas bshad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel ba'i cho gas yun ring po'i bar du bla mchod gsol 'debs kyi rim pa'i mchod sprin spros/ rgya mtsho dpon dge 'dun bkra shis kyis gtso mdzad rdo rje 'dzin pa mang po'i snying po'i snying po mchog tu gyur pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang lhan cig tu phul/ gzhan yang chos grwa chen por sku rim du khag g.yar ba'i mchod 'bul sogs ni bgrang ba las 'das/

de nas lo de'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la sku gdung rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'bar byed kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su kyai rdo rje nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi mchod pa'i phyag len 'khrul med mdo dang rgyud sde kun la dbang phyug pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal pas mdzad/ de nyin yang phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'ja' 'od sna lngas khyab cing / lhag par sku gdung la bzhu me phul ba'i spur dud thams cad 'ja' 'od kho nar song ba'i kun gsal gyi pha mtha' thams cad khyab pa dang me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ji ltar pra phab pa'i mig ngor gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba ltar gdul bya'i mos blo dang mthun pa'i mthong snang ngo mtshar can mang du byung 'dug pa rnams ni so sor bri bar ma nus so/ /de nas gdung khang la phyag rgyas btab ste bdun phrag gcig gi bar du legs par mchod nas zhal phye ste rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i cho gas gdung rus rnams spyan drangs pas dbu thod phal che ba ril por byon/ dbu'i gtsug tor gyi phyi logs la gur gyi mgon po'i zhal gdong shin tu che zhing gsal ba rang chas su yod pa de mngon du gyur/ zhal gdong de'i spyan g.yas tshang bug dang nye ba na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma theb sor gyi tshad tsam 'bur du dod pa/ spyan g.yon na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gzhan yang bde mchog pa gcig sogs lha sku yig 'bru ring bsrel dang bcas sku gsung thugs kyi brten ngo mtshar dpag med dang me bya dung gi tshem gcig 'khrungs yod pa de yang ril por byon/ de'i tshe ma 'ongs pa'i lung bstan mngon du gyur te me tog gi char kha ba 'bab 'bab gdung khang dang gzim chung steng 'og thams cad du 'thus pa'i chog pa bab cing / lhag par gdung khang gi drung du shin tu che ba babs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pas ting phor gang byung ba mchod pa'i rjes su phul/ gdung rus lhag ma chu shel ltar dwangs ba lus pa med pa 'jim pa gtsang ma dri bzang po'i chus rin po che dang lhan tu sbrus nas rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyi phyag tsha sku par du blugs te/

sngags 'chang bla ma'i sku brnyan/ gong ma lnga tshar/ sngags 'chang yab sras/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug slob dpon pad+ma/ rdo rje 'chang / 'od dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa/ thub dbang gtso 'khor gsum/ byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ 'jigs byed/ phyag rdor/ u tsa/ spyan gzigs/ rnam rgyal/ rnam rgyal mchod rten/ mchod sku ma brgya rtsa/ tshe dpag med sogs sku brnyan stong phrag gcig dang brgya nga gsum/ de thams cad la gser chab rdzib 'bul du zho bcu drug gi zhabs tog dang / gzhan yang dar zab kyi na bza' sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbus su bzhugs shing dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su bkangs pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ mkha' spyod dbang mo mkha' 'gro 'bum bcas kyis/ /'dzum dkar g.yo ba'i lang tsho yang yang bstan/ /las kyi mgon po zhal bzhi pa rnams kyang / /gang gis bzhed don sgrub pa'i pho nyar chas/ 1 /de tshe nor 'dzin nyul gyi 'tshub ma bral/ /sprin med mkha' la 'ja' 'od 'phreng ba 'khrigs/ /rol mo'i sgra dang dri zhim phyogs kun khyab/ /puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i char chen rtag par phab/ 2 /rmad byung ngo mtshar ltas dang cho 'phrul gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyon 'di rab bkangs nas/ /kyai ma chos sku brnyes kyang gdul bya'i ngor/ /kun khyab 'gro ba'i mgon po gshegs tshul bstan/ 3 /'jigs rung mi zad rin chen 'byung gnas su/ /dam pa'i ded dpon lan gcig rnyed pa de/ /'ja' 'od sgyu 'phrul ji bzhin myur bar yal/ /da ni mgon med bdag rnams ci zhig bya/ 4 /las kyi rta ljang shing rta'i rtser phyogs pas/ /sems kyi duḥkha nyi ma'i thigs 'phreng gi /tsit+ta'i ku mud zum pa'i ngal ba las/ /'gram pa'i kun+da lag pa'i chu mtshor bstan/ 5 /gtsang gnas rigs kyi lha bu gzhon nu yis/ /ngo mtshar ltas dang mtshan ma sna tshogs pa/ /re zhig dus na 'di dang 'di 'byung zhes/ /lung bstan bdud rtsi'i thigs pa snying la bsim/ 6 /bstan 'gror dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed lhag bsam gyis/
