/mchog gsum dges pa'i spyod tshul lhur mdzad cing / /ma nor blang dor gsal bar ston mkhas pa'i/ /brtse ba'i 'dzum zhal yid la yang yang bcag 7 /'di 'dra'i gnas skabs dngos su mthong gyur kyang / /da dung gces 'dzin 'gong po mi 'dul ba/ /me tog gzhu can mthu las gzhan du ci/ /nam yang brtse bas ma 'dor thugs rje can/ 8 /mi dge'i las kyi dus kyi mthar skyes pas/ /rmongs pa bdag la re sa gzhan med pas/ /'di nas bzung ste chos sku ma thob bar/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang khyed kyi thugs rjes gzigs/ 9 /lnga pa rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las rgya chen pos kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ji ltar spel ba'i tshul ni/ rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las gaṅga'i rgyun/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams 'dzin mar legs phabs tshe/ /phan bde'i rtsa ljang myu gu ci mi skye/ /rgyal bstan 'bras bu'i khur chen 'di na lci/ /zhes te/ lo de'i zla ba dang po'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes gsum nas brtsams gdan sa chen po 'di nyid rang du sku gzhogs grwa tshang ban tshang pa rnams kyi gtsos dge 'dun bcu phrag drug gi dbus su lha khang mkhan rin po che nyid phebs te zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar du theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse rje btsun nā ro pas bkral ba'i mkha' spyod dbang mo'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye/ thub bstan lha chen du dge 'dun brgya phrag mang pos lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i mchod sprin rgya chen po spros/ de mtshams thub bstan rin chen gling / na ring gsang sngags gling / chu 'dus chos sde/ nyi shar chos sde/ thub bstan dge 'phel/ bsam 'grub dgon gsar/ mdar grang mo che/ rags rdzongs/ rgyang / gdong dga' chos sde/ 'dzims chos lung / phu gsum chos sde/ 'dra 'dri/ chos 'khor lhun po/ nor bu chos 'phel sogs nye 'dab na gnas pa'i klog spong gi sde so so nas bla ma slob dpon grwa btsun pho mo stong phrag gnyis la nye ba tsam 'dus/

tshes brgyad nas bcu gcig gi bar la sprul pa'i lha khang chen mor rigs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid gtso bor phebs te mchod pa'i sprin phung kun bzang rnam 'phrul la 'gran pa lta bu btsugs pa'i rgyun gyi phogs dang / nyin re bzhin 'bras 'jam/ mang ja/ spu ja sogs bzang ja sbyor lnga re tshogs chas dang bcas pa phyag mdzod nas star chags su zhus/ chog yon nyi ma dang po la ja dngul phor re/ bar pa la grwa pa bcu re'i sar bkras thags/ gos kha 'brel/ sman tse kha 'brel/ khom bu/ gos chen/ lho ras yug spu kha yug te bdun tshan re/ gsum pa la grwa pa zhal grangs drug re'i sar gser zho 'khor re/ bla ma slob dpon so sor tshan grang dgu tshan nas bdun tshan gyi bar skabs 'brel/ nyin bzhi pa la zhal ngo so so chos sde spyi pa/ sku 'khor du gtogs pa rnams kyi rnyed bkur 'bul 'gyed gya noms pa bsgrubs/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi tshes bcu gnyis dus chen thog chos khri chen mor gnang ba'i gdan sa chen po'i gtsug lag khang thams cad du dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod sprin gyi 'phreng ba thub pa gangs can mtsho'i mdun sa bzhin bshams/ bla ma slob dpon las chen zur 'bul 'os pa rnams la tshan grangs stobs che ba/ gzhis byes kyi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa stong phrag bco lnga tsam long pa la mang ja gdan non gzab ma'i steng dge 'dun rnams la spyi 'gyed dpangs mtho ba/ mi sder ja dngul phor re sogs zang zing gi sbyin gtong bsam las 'das pa zhig bsgrubs/ de dang rjes 'brel gling kha bde ba can du dge 'dun bsnyen song brgya sum cu skor gyis zhag nyer lnga'i bar la 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye/ mus nang gi dgon so so 'dus pa'i zhal grangs stong phrag la nye ba dang bcas pa'i mchod pa'i rgyun chen po dang / skye bo'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa la zang zing gi sbyin gtong dang /

dge 'dun rnams la rnyed bkur 'bul 'gyed mchod sprin sogs gdan sa 'di nyid du ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin bsgrubs/ de skabs lha sa nas sa gsum gyi 'dren pa dam pa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po/ rtse gdong lhun rtse/ bkra shis lhun po/ e waṃ chos ldan/ bde chen chos 'khor sogs dbus gtsang nor 'dzin gyi 'khyon na gnas pa'i che dgu thams cad kyi gdung 'bul/ snyan dar/ gdung sor sogs rgya chen po byung / chos sde rang rang so sor mchod 'bul dang gsol 'debs zhu ba ni bgrang ba las 'das/ lha sar jo bo rin po che'i drung du chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i sku char 'bul ba dang bstan 'gro la dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed bzang po'i smon lam 'bum ther sgrub par dam pa rang nyid kyi dgongs gtad bzhin rab 'byams smra ba chos 'phel gyis rtag 'grus su bsgrubs pa mdzad/ gzhan yang rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa sogs chos kyi spyan ldan rnams la mchod 'bul bsngo rten/ e waṃ chos ldan/ thub bstan gong 'og gser mdog can/ bkra shis lhun po/ ngam ring / dpal 'khor chos sde/ ser 'bras/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan sogs dbus gtsang gi dgon gnas rigs su ma bcad pa che phra nyis brgya sum cu rtsa grangs su mang ja 'gyed bcas bsngo rten mtshan grangs rgya chen po sgrub pa'i tshul rnams mchod 'bul deb chen du gsal ba ltar yin pas re re nas brjod mi nus te bgrang ba las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dgongs pa zab mo chos kyi dbyings dag par 'gang pa'i bya ba rnams rags rim grub rjes/ rten bzhengs chen mo grub par mngon du bzhed de/ zla ba de'i nyer gnyis/ lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nyin nas bzo grwa gtsug mchod gnas bla ma chos rje rgyal mtshan/ bzo mgo pa kun dga' lnga ldan lags/ thig rtsa 'debs pa sogs kyi bkod pa sprul sku bdo gong pas phyag len la thebs par mdzad de/

bal po chos rgyal sogs bcu gcig gis gtsug tor dri ma med pa las gsungs pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi nang nas/ yangs pa can du sku tshe byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten du grags pa'i dbyibs ji lta bar gser dngul sogs rin po che las grub pa rgya dpangs che zhing 'dzam bu gling 'dir mchog tu gyur pa bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa dang / dam pa de nyid kyi sku tshab thog tshad ma gser zangs las grub pa lta bas ngoms pa med pa'i mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od can/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bi rū pa'i sku brnyan rkang gang tsam dang bcas zla ba bzhi'i khongs su legs par grub pa'i sku rgyur/ zangs khal lnga bcu nga brgyad/ dngul khal drug nyag gang / gser btso thon zho lnga brgya dang bcu gsum/ dngul chu srang nyis brgya/ phra rgyan la gru dkar dmar gtso bor gyur pa'i g.yu'i rdo rje rgya gram gsum/ rdo rje gser gyi mtha' bcas bcu bdun/ gser spyi che chung brgyad/ gser pan che chung 'dres pa nyer brgyad/ gser g.yu'i sog skor che chung 'dres pa drug gser gyi khrom tshar gnyis/ gañja mu tig stong phrag gcig dang nyer gcig byu ru che chung 'dres pa drug brgya dang drug cu re drug byir lcug rgya gzhogs ma ring ba lnga/ pad+ma rā ga gnyis brgya dang bco lnga/ dpral g.yu bzhi/ g.yu sprel gcig drug dkar dmar kho na bcas pa'i g.yu che chung 'dres pa nyis brgya/ me shel lnga bcu nga gsum/ g.yang kri'i 'phreng ba sogs gtso bor gyur pa'i nor bu'i phra rgyan khyad 'phags 'ba' zhig grangs las 'das pas mdzes par spras zhing / de rnams kyi nang bzhugs la sku gdung rin po che las byon pa'i lha sku ring bsrel yig 'bru'i tshogs dang / gdung tsha gtso bor gyur pa'i gzungs dang byin rlabs kyi rten grangs dang tshad med pa zhig so so'i dkar chag tu gsal ba ltar gyi phyur bur bltams pa'i dngul gdung rin po che nyid bzhi thog bla brang gi rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i shar ngos dang /

de'i mdun thad nub nas shar gzigs la sku 'dra rin po che dgos 'dod kun 'byung nyid/ mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa dang bcas ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar du lha bcas 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par bzhugs su gsol/ de bstun gong du bkod pa'i rgyal ba'i 'khrungs rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'brel ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa mdzad pa'i bris thang nyer dgu gegs med mthar phyin pa'i gtso thang gsum dang / sngags 'chang yab sras/ 'dren pa dam pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa sbyin bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa rnams la tog gser 'jang brdung zho bzhi bcu/ gzhan ma rnams kyi tog dngul gar lugs las grub pa'i rgyur dngul srang nyer brgyad dang zho brgyad/ sku brnyan rnams la gser zho sum cu so bdun bcas gzhan las ches khyad bar du 'phags pa 'di rnams kyang bsgrubs te/ mdor na gangs can gyi khrod 'dir rten gsum gsar du bskrun pa la 'di rnams las bzo khyad khyad par du 'phags pa dang / sku rgyu snang che ba med par grags la/ rten gsum de dag gi spyan sngar mdo sde phal po che'i gleng gzhi las gsungs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po legs par bstar ba la rab tu gnas pa'i byin rlabs kyi char rgyun 'bebs pa po 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs mgon mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gtso bor phebs pa'i phyag phyir rgyal rtse zhabs drung bla ma'i drung / thub bstan lha chen gyi mkhan rin po che/ bzang ldan slob dpon pa chen po ngag dbang rnam rgyal sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu phrag gsum lhag tsam gyis dges pa rdo rje la rten pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho gas byin rlabs kyis gzi 'od 'bar ba mdzad/ slad nas kyang dus rgyun gyi mchod par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod/ kyai rdor rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi rgyud 'don/

bla ma mchod chog rnams nar mar sgrub pa dang / lo dus kyi mchod 'bul chen mor rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye ste zhag grangs nyi shu'i bar du sgrub cing mchod pa dang / de bstun thub bstan lha chen du mchod 'bul rgya chen po/ gzhan yang e waṃ chos ldan/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan/ nyang stod rtse chen rnams su zhag grangs mang po'i bar la bla med kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes te mchod sprin rgya mtsho lta bu dang / gling kha bde ba can du zhag bdun gyi bar la dge 'dun mang pos 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye ba/ gzhan yang gser mdog can/ srid gsum rnam rgyal/ yul chen/ nyi shar chos sde/ gdong dga' chos sde/ bsam yas rab byung sogs sa rigs kyi dgon chen phal che bar sgrub cing mchod pa sogs gsol 'debs rgya chen po bgyid pa la stsol ba lhur len rgyal bstan rin po che ji srid gnas kyi bar du rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba'i so sor gzhi rten mtha' yas pa zhig sbyor bar mdzad pa rnams 'dir yi ge'i tshegs skyung phyir zhib par ma spros so/ /de thams cad kyi bya ba mdzad pa po 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs mgon mtshungs pa ma mchis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gi bka' bzhin/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i 'phrin las par smon lam gyi mthu yongs su grub pa phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan pas thugs khur bzhes te/ nyer 'tshe'i rnam pa cung zad kyang med cing ring por ma thogs pa legs par grub pa 'di ni mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo bka' drin mnyam med sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid kyi thugs rje las gzhan du ma mchis so/ /don de dag la 'di skad/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gang 'dus mdzad pa yis/ /myang 'das zhi bar gzims kyang 'od srung gi /sku gdung mchod rten mang po'i bka' drin dang /

/rgyal ba'i gsung rab bsdu ba'i khur khyer bzhin/ 1 /'jam mgon rigs dang chos las 'khrungs pa'i lha/ /sa gsum 'di na 'gran zla ma mchis pa/ /bsod nams mi zad gser gyi lhun po mchog /chos dang srid kyi dbang phyug che des bka'/ 2 /legs byas bsod nams yongs 'du'i dpag bsam dbang / /dad 'dun rtsa ba rab brtan rnam dpyod kyis/ /gzigs pa nam mkha'i rjes 'gro skyes chen des/ /nam yang mi g.yel gus spro chen po yis/ 3 /dpal 'byor pha mtha' yas pa yongs 'khyil bas/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye nas/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la lan brgyar rnyed bkur dang / /skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin pa'i bka' drin mdzad/ 4 /bslab gsum nor gyis phyug pa'i ngur smrig sde/ /bshad sgrub nyis brgya bcu phrag gsum lhag la/ /rnyed bkur kun bzang mchod sprin mtha' yas pas/ /dam pa'i thugs dgongs ma lus yongs su bkang / 5 /gang la ci dges dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char/ /yongs 'du'i dpag bsam la 'gran thugs kyi rten/ /chu shes mdog mtshungs byin rlabs gzi 'od can/ /lha mi'i bsod nams mgron gyi phul du bsgrubs/ 6 /gser gyi lhun po la yang skyengs ster ba'i/ /lta bas mi ngoms mtshan pa'i lang tsho can/ /dge legs rin chen las grub sku'i snang brnyan/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i legs byas zhing du bskrun/ 7 /de tshe gzu bor gnas pa'i dpyod ldan kun/ /'di ci nam mkha' mdzod la dbang 'byor ram/ /yang na rnam thos bu yi sgyu 'phrul zhes/ /khyod snyan brjod pa'i mgrin pa ring du skyong / 8 /de ltar rigs brgya'i mgon po sngags 'chang rjes/ /zab dgongs chos dbyings kun gsal dag pa'i klong / /yongs su skong ba'i legs byas ji snyed pa/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa smon lam mthu/ 9 /zhes rigs brgya'i mgon po bka' drin mnyam med rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho lta bu las sgro bkur spangs te rags pa chu thigs tsam zhig brjod pa legs par bstan zin to/

/'dir smras pa/ dam pa'i rtogs brjod dge legs 'bum gyi khyim/ /gzhan phan bsil zer bye ba 'dzag pa can/ /mthong bas skal bzang yid kyi ku mud tshal/ /kun dga'i 'dab ma phyogs brgyar cis mi 'dzum/ 1 /mgon de'i gsung dang rang gi mos blo yis/ /legs sbyar 'di la nyes pa ma mchis mod/ /byis pa'i blo yis 'khrul par 'gyur pa gang / /de nyid gzigs pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ 2 /thub dbang bla ma'i ngo mtshar gtam nyid kyi/ /dad pas blo gsal skal ldan yid tshim zhing / /mu cor smra ba rnams kyi bsten pa'i tshig /yid 'ong sems pa nyid dang bral bar byed/ 3 /kun mkhyen go 'phang ji srid ma thob bar/ /dga' bzhi'i tshul khrims dri med gtsang ma yis/ /blo gros dbang po gsal ba'i chos can gyis/ /yang dag shes bya'i snang ba gsal par shog 4 /khyod zhabs pad+mo bsten pa'i bka' drin las/ /skye ba kun tu khyed kyi zhal mthong zhing / /gdams pa'i nying khus mos pa'i yid tshim nas/ /mi 'gyur bde ba che la rol bar shog 5 /tshul 'di 'bad pas dge tshogs kun+da dang / /zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba gang thob des/ /skye dgu'i sgrib gnyis mun pa'i dpung bcom nas/ /rnam grol thar pa'i lam la 'god gyur cig 6 /bkra shis dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i sgo/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du/ /lung rtogs bdag nyid rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /lugs zung yar ngo'i zla tshes bzhin gyur cig 7 /bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mgon po khyod dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun zhabs pad+mo/ /dad pa'i gtsug gi 'bral med bsten par shog 8 /dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin rlabs dang / /mchog gsum srung mar bcas pa'i mthu stobs dang / rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa yis/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'grub pa'i shis pas skyongs/ 9 /de ltar 'gro ba lha dang mi'i skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen mtshungs pa ma mchis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma
